common_mistake.right: The finding was deemed critical.
common_mistake.why: deem takes a complement directly; no 'as'

cloze.sentence: Any password shorter than eight characters is ____ weak.

en_def: weak, thin, or uncertain; likely to break or fail
hi_nuance: Learners say 'weak' for everything. 'Tenuous' is used for links, arguments, and positions that barely hold together: 'a tenuous connection'. Not for physical weakness or weak tea.

examples.en: The link between the two incidents is tenuous at best.
examples.hi: दोनों घटनाओं के बीच का संबंध अधिक से अधिक कमज़ोर है।

examples.en: He has only a tenuous grasp of the subject.
examples.hi: विषय पर उसकी पकड़ बहुत कमज़ोर है।

examples.en: The coalition's hold on power is increasingly tenuous.
examples.hi: सत्ता पर गठबंधन की पकड़ लगातार कमज़ोर होती जा रही है।

examples.en: Their argument rests on a tenuous assumption.
examples.hi: उनका तर्क एक कमज़ोर धारणा पर टिका है।

examples.en: The evidence connecting him to the attack is tenuous.
examples.hi: उसे हमले से जोड़ने वाले सबूत कमज़ोर हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This tea is very tenuous.
common_mistake.right: This tea is very weak.
common_mistake.why: tenuous describes abstract links and arguments, not drinks or bodies

cloze.sentence: The claim that the vendor was at fault rests on ____ evidence.

en_def: strong and unlikely to fail; able to withstand pressure or errors
hi_nuance: Engineers know 'robust code'. Also used for arguments, growth, and health. Stress falls on the second syllable: ro-BUST. Learners often stress the first.

examples.en: We need a more robust backup strategy before the migration.
examples.hi: माइग्रेशन से पहले हमें अधिक मज़बूत बैकअप रणनीति चाहिए।

examples.en: The economy showed robust growth in the third quarter.
examples.hi: तीसरी तिमाही में अर्थव्यवस्था ने मज़बूत वृद्धि दिखाई।

examples.en: The system remained robust under heavy load.
examples.hi: भारी लोड के तहत भी सिस्टम मज़बूत बना रहा।

examples.en: She gave a robust defence of the new policy.
examples.hi: उसने नई नीति का ज़ोरदार बचाव किया।

examples.en: Robust input validation stops most injection attacks.
examples.hi: मज़बूत इनपुट सत्यापन अधिकांश इंजेक्शन हमलों को रोक देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The robustness of the code is very robust.
common_mistake.right: The code is very robust.
common_mistake.why: avoid repeating the root; use the adjective once

cloze.sentence: The team built a ____ pipeline that survives partial outages.

en_def: dealing with things in a practical, sensible way rather than by fixed ideas
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'practical' for both people and solutions. 'Pragmatic' is the more sophisticated word for an approach or person who prefers what works over what is ideal.

examples.en: We took a pragmatic approach and shipped the partial fix first.
examples.hi: हमने व्यावहारिक रुख अपनाया और पहले आंशिक सुधार जारी किया।

examples.en: She is pragmatic about the limits of what one team can do.
examples.hi: वह इस बारे में व्यावहारिक है कि एक टीम कितना कर सकती है।

examples.en: A pragmatic compromise ended the dispute.
examples.hi: एक व्यावहारिक समझौते ने विवाद को समाप्त कर दिया।

examples.en: The new manager is more pragmatic than his predecessor.
examples.hi: नया प्रबंधक अपने पूर्ववर्ती से अधिक व्यावहारिक है।

examples.en: Pragmatic security means accepting some risk to keep the business running.
examples.hi: व्यावहारिक सुरक्षा का अर्थ है व्यवसाय चलाए रखने के लिए कुछ जोखिम स्वीकार करना।

common_mistake.wrong: He is very pragmatic person.
common_mistake.right: He is a very pragmatic person.
common_mistake.why: a singular countable noun needs an article

cloze.sentence: Rather than rewrite everything, we chose the ____ option of patching the old module.

en_def: giving very careful attention to every detail
hi_def: अत्यंत सावधान, बारीकी से ध्यान देने वाला
hi_nuance: A strong compliment in performance reviews. Learners say 'very careful' or 'perfect'. Note the collocation 'meticulous attention to detail'.

examples.en: She keeps meticulous records of every change to the system.
examples.hi: वह सिस्टम के हर बदलाव का अत्यंत सावधानी से रिकॉर्ड रखती है।

examples.en: The report was meticulous in its analysis of the failure.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट विफलता के विश्लेषण में बेहद बारीक थी।

examples.en: He is meticulous about testing before he commits.
examples.hi: वह कमिट करने से पहले परीक्षण को लेकर बहुत सावधान रहता है।

examples.en: Meticulous planning made the event run smoothly.
examples.hi: सावधानीपूर्वक योजना ने कार्यक्रम को सुचारु रूप से चलाया।

examples.en: The restoration was carried out with meticulous care.
examples.hi: जीर्णोद्धार अत्यंत सावधानी से किया गया।

common_mistake.wrong: She did the work very meticulous.
common_mistake.right: She did the work very meticulously.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed to modify the verb

cloze.sentence: The forensic team kept a ____ log of every file it examined.

en_def: showing awareness of small but important differences in meaning or situation
hi_def: सूक्ष्म भेदों वाला, बारीकियों को समझने वाला
hi_nuance: Praise for arguments and opinions: 'a nuanced view'. Learners say 'detailed' or 'balanced'; 'nuanced' specifically means not black-and-white. The noun 'nuance' is also C1.

examples.en: The article offers a nuanced view of the immigration debate.
examples.hi: लेख आप्रवासन बहस पर एक सूक्ष्म और संतुलित दृष्टिकोण प्रस्तुत करता है।

examples.en: Her answer was more nuanced than a simple yes or no.
examples.hi: उसका उत्तर साधारण हाँ या ना से अधिक सूक्ष्म था।

examples.en: Risk assessment requires a nuanced understanding of the business.
examples.hi: जोखिम आकलन के लिए व्यवसाय की बारीक समझ आवश्यक है।

examples.en: The actor gave a nuanced performance.
examples.hi: अभिनेता ने बारीकियों से भरा अभिनय किया।

examples.en: We need a more nuanced policy than 'block everything'.
examples.hi: हमें 'सब कुछ ब्लॉक करो' से अधिक सूक्ष्म नीति चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: His opinion is very nuance.
common_mistake.right: His opinion is very nuanced.
common_mistake.why: 'nuance' is the noun; the adjective is 'nuanced'

cloze.sentence: The analyst gave a ____ answer that acknowledged both sides.

en_def: so small or unimportant that it can be ignored
hi_nuance: Learners say 'very less' (an Indianism) or 'very small'. 'Negligible' is the precise word in reports: 'the performance impact is negligible'. Do not confuse with 'negligent' (लापरवाह).

examples.en: The performance impact of the extra check is negligible.
examples.hi: अतिरिक्त जाँच का प्रदर्शन पर प्रभाव नगण्य है।

examples.en: The difference in price between the two plans is negligible.
examples.hi: दोनों योजनाओं की कीमत में अंतर नगण्य है।

examples.en: The risk of a false positive is negligible.
examples.hi: गलत सकारात्मक परिणाम का जोखिम नगण्य है।

examples.en: Sales rose by a negligible amount last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने बिक्री नगण्य मात्रा में बढ़ी।

examples.en: The side effects were negligible in most patients.
examples.hi: अधिकांश रोगियों में दुष्प्रभाव नगण्य थे।

common_mistake.wrong: The delay is very less, almost negligent.
common_mistake.right: The delay is negligible.
common_mistake.why: 'very less' is not English, and negligent means careless

cloze.sentence: The extra memory used by logging is ____ compared with the database.

en_def: directly relevant to the matter being discussed
hi_nuance: A formal synonym of 'relevant'. Indian English says 'it is pertinent to mention that', which is heavy; natives prefer 'it is worth noting that'. Use 'pertinent' for questions and facts.

examples.en: She asked several pertinent questions about the budget.
examples.hi: उसने बजट के बारे में कई प्रासंगिक प्रश्न पूछे।

examples.en: Please include only the details pertinent to the incident.
examples.hi: कृपया केवल घटना से संबंधित विवरण ही शामिल करें।

examples.en: His remarks were not pertinent to the discussion.
examples.hi: उसकी टिप्पणियाँ चर्चा से संबंधित नहीं थीं।

examples.en: The report highlights the pertinent facts on page two.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट पृष्ठ दो पर प्रासंगिक तथ्यों को उजागर करती है।

examples.en: That is a pertinent point; let us return to it later.
examples.hi: यह एक प्रासंगिक बात है; हम इस पर बाद में लौटेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: It is pertinent to mention here that the server crashed.
common_mistake.right: It is worth noting that the server crashed.
common_mistake.why: the Indian-English formula sounds bureaucratic; keep 'pertinent' for facts and questions

cloze.sentence: Only the logs ____ to the breach were shared with the auditor.

en_def: very convincing, or so interesting that it holds your attention
hi_nuance: Two senses: 'compelling evidence' (convincing) and 'a compelling story' (gripping). Learners overuse 'strong'; 'compelling' shows nuance in reviews and proposals.

examples.en: There is compelling evidence that the account was compromised.
examples.hi: इस बात के प्रभावशाली सबूत हैं कि खाता समझौता किया गया था।

examples.en: She made a compelling case for moving to the cloud.
examples.hi: उसने क्लाउड में जाने के लिए एक विश्वसनीय तर्क प्रस्तुत किया।

examples.en: The documentary tells a compelling story.
examples.hi: यह वृत्तचित्र एक बाँध लेने वाली कहानी कहता है।

examples.en: Without a compelling reason, the change will not be approved.
examples.hi: बिना किसी ठोस कारण के बदलाव को मंज़ूरी नहीं मिलेगी।

examples.en: The demo was compelling enough to win the contract.
examples.hi: डेमो इतना प्रभावशाली था कि अनुबंध मिल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The proof is very compelled.
common_mistake.right: The proof is very compelling.
common_mistake.why: 'compelled' means forced; the adjective for convincing is 'compelling'

cloze.sentence: The auditor found the team's explanation ____ and closed the finding.

en_def: making a particular result likely or possible
hi_nuance: Always followed by 'to': 'conducive to learning'. Indian writers often use it correctly but drop the 'to'. It describes environments and conditions, not people.

examples.en: A quiet room is more conducive to concentration.
examples.hi: शांत कमरा एकाग्रता के लिए अधिक अनुकूल होता है।

examples.en: The current culture is not conducive to reporting mistakes.
examples.hi: वर्तमान संस्कृति गलतियों की रिपोर्ट करने के अनुकूल नहीं है।

examples.en: Low interest rates are conducive to investment.
examples.hi: कम ब्याज दरें निवेश के लिए अनुकूल होती हैं।

examples.en: Open-plan offices are not always conducive to deep work.
examples.hi: खुले कार्यालय हमेशा गहन कार्य के अनुकूल नहीं होते।

examples.en: Regular sleep is conducive to good health.
examples.hi: नियमित नींद अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के लिए अनुकूल है।

common_mistake.wrong: The atmosphere was conducive for study.
common_mistake.right: The atmosphere was conducive to study.
common_mistake.why: conducive always takes 'to'

cloze.sentence: Constant interruptions are not ____ to careful code review.

en_def: likely to cause disagreement or argument
hi_nuance: Learners say 'controversial'; both work, but 'contentious' is more common for issues within a group (a contentious meeting, a contentious clause).

examples.en: Pay is always a contentious issue in negotiations.
examples.hi: वेतन बातचीत में हमेशा एक विवादास्पद मुद्दा होता है।

examples.en: The most contentious clause was removed from the contract.
examples.hi: सबसे विवादास्पद खंड अनुबंध से हटा दिया गया।

examples.en: Whether to rewrite or refactor was a contentious decision.
examples.hi: दोबारा लिखें या रीफ़ैक्टर करें, यह एक विवादास्पद निर्णय था।

examples.en: The meeting became contentious when budgets were discussed.
examples.hi: बजट पर चर्चा होते ही बैठक विवादपूर्ण हो गई।

examples.en: Data retention remains a contentious topic among privacy experts.
examples.hi: डेटा प्रतिधारण गोपनीयता विशेषज्ञों के बीच एक विवादास्पद विषय बना हुआ है।

common_mistake.wrong: The topic is very contention.
common_mistake.right: The topic is very contentious.
common_mistake.why: 'contention' is the noun; use the adjective after 'is'

cloze.sentence: The proposal to log all employee keystrokes proved highly ____.

en_def: able to be believed or trusted; convincing
hi_nuance: Do not confuse with 'credulous' (too ready to believe, भोला) or 'creditable' (deserving praise). 'A credible threat' is a fixed phrase in security.

examples.en: We received a credible threat and raised the alert level.
examples.hi: हमें एक विश्वसनीय ख़तरे की सूचना मिली और हमने अलर्ट स्तर बढ़ा दिया।

examples.en: Her account of events was entirely credible.
examples.hi: घटनाओं का उसका विवरण पूरी तरह विश्वसनीय था।

examples.en: Is there a credible alternative to the current vendor?
examples.hi: क्या वर्तमान विक्रेता का कोई विश्वसनीय विकल्प है?

examples.en: The witness did not seem credible to the jury.
examples.hi: गवाह जूरी को विश्वसनीय नहीं लगा।

examples.en: Only credible sources should be cited in the report.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट में केवल विश्वसनीय स्रोतों का ही हवाला दिया जाना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: The website is a very credulous source.
common_mistake.right: The website is a very credible source.
common_mistake.why: credulous means gullible; credible means believable

cloze.sentence: The witness did not seem ____ to the jury.

en_def: increasing by successive additions; building up over time
hi_nuance: Learners say 'total'. 'Cumulative' stresses the process of adding up: cumulative effect, cumulative total. Stress: CU-mu-la-tive.

examples.en: The cumulative effect of small delays pushed the launch back a month.
examples.hi: छोटी-छोटी देरियों के संचयी प्रभाव ने लॉन्च को एक महीना पीछे धकेल दिया।

examples.en: Cumulative sales passed one million units in May.
examples.hi: मई में संचयी बिक्री दस लाख इकाइयों को पार कर गई।

examples.en: Ten minutes of daily practice has a cumulative benefit.
examples.hi: प्रतिदिन दस मिनट के अभ्यास का संचयी लाभ होता है।

examples.en: The chart shows the cumulative number of vulnerabilities fixed.
examples.hi: चार्ट ठीक की गई कमज़ोरियों की संचयी संख्या दिखाता है।

examples.en: Exposure to noise has a cumulative impact on hearing.
examples.hi: शोर के संपर्क का सुनने पर संचयी प्रभाव पड़ता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The cumulated effect was serious.
common_mistake.right: The cumulative effect was serious.
common_mistake.why: the adjective is 'cumulative'; 'cumulated' is not standard

cloze.sentence: The ____ cost of technical debt eventually exceeded the cost of a rewrite.

en_def: causing harm or damage
hi_nuance: Formal for 'harmful'. Always 'detrimental to'. Learners write 'detrimental for'. Common in health, environment, and business reports.

examples.en: Skipping backups is detrimental to the company's resilience.
examples.hi: बैकअप छोड़ना कंपनी की लचीलापन के लिए हानिकारक है।

examples.en: Lack of sleep is detrimental to memory.
examples.hi: नींद की कमी स्मृति के लिए हानिकारक है।

examples.en: The policy had a detrimental effect on morale.
examples.hi: नीति का मनोबल पर हानिकारक प्रभाव पड़ा।

examples.en: Prolonged screen time can be detrimental to children's eyesight.
examples.hi: लंबे समय तक स्क्रीन देखना बच्चों की आँखों के लिए हानिकारक हो सकता है।

examples.en: Any leak would be highly detrimental to our reputation.
examples.hi: कोई भी लीक हमारी प्रतिष्ठा के लिए बेहद हानिकारक होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Smoking is detrimental for health.
common_mistake.right: Smoking is detrimental to health.
common_mistake.why: detrimental always takes 'to'

cloze.sentence: Publishing the exploit details early would be ____ to unpatched users.

en_def: about to happen very soon, often something unpleasant
hi_nuance: Confused with 'eminent' (प्रतिष्ठित) and 'immanent' (philosophy). 'Imminent' is about time: 'an imminent attack', 'in imminent danger'.

examples.en: Intelligence suggested an attack was imminent.
examples.hi: ख़ुफ़िया जानकारी से संकेत मिला कि हमला आसन्न था।

examples.en: The company is in imminent danger of losing its licence.
examples.hi: कंपनी अपना लाइसेंस खोने के आसन्न ख़तरे में है।

examples.en: With the deadline imminent, the team worked through the night.
examples.hi: समय-सीमा नज़दीक होने पर टीम ने रात भर काम किया।

examples.en: There is no imminent threat to the system.
examples.hi: सिस्टम को कोई आसन्न ख़तरा नहीं है।

examples.en: The announcement of the merger is imminent.
examples.hi: विलय की घोषणा बहुत जल्द होने वाली है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is an imminent scientist.
common_mistake.right: He is an eminent scientist.
common_mistake.why: eminent = distinguished; imminent = about to happen

cloze.sentence: The patch was rushed out because exploitation was ____.

en_def: done without intention; accidental
hi_nuance: The polite word for 'by mistake' in incident reports: 'inadvertent disclosure'. Learners say 'unknowingly' or 'by mistake', which are fine in speech but less formal.

examples.en: The leak was the result of an inadvertent misconfiguration.
examples.hi: लीक अनजाने में हुई गलत कॉन्फ़िगरेशन का परिणाम था।

examples.en: An engineer inadvertently deleted the production table.
examples.hi: एक इंजीनियर ने अनजाने में प्रोडक्शन तालिका हटा दी।

examples.en: We apologise for any inadvertent errors in the invoice.
examples.hi: चालान में किसी भी अनजाने त्रुटि के लिए हम क्षमा चाहते हैं।

examples.en: The inadvertent disclosure affected around 400 customers.
examples.hi: अनजाने में हुए खुलासे ने लगभग 400 ग्राहकों को प्रभावित किया।

examples.en: His inadvertent remark offended the client.
examples.hi: उसकी अनजाने में कही गई टिप्पणी ने ग्राहक को नाराज़ कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I did it inadvertent.
common_mistake.right: I did it inadvertently.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed to modify the verb

cloze.sentence: The secret key was ____ committed to a public repository.

en_def: happening in small, regular stages rather than all at once
hi_nuance: Engineers know 'incremental backup'. As a general adjective it describes change: 'incremental improvements'. Learners say 'step by step' in formal writing where 'incremental' fits better.

examples.en: We prefer incremental releases to one big launch.
examples.hi: हम एक बड़े लॉन्च के बजाय क्रमिक रिलीज़ पसंद करते हैं।

examples.en: The gains were incremental but consistent.
examples.hi: लाभ क्रमिक थे लेकिन लगातार थे।

examples.en: Incremental backups run every hour.
examples.hi: क्रमिक बैकअप हर घंटे चलते हैं।

examples.en: Language learning is incremental; there is no single breakthrough.
examples.hi: भाषा सीखना क्रमिक है; कोई एक बड़ी सफलता नहीं होती।

examples.en: The budget allows for incremental hiring over two years.
examples.hi: बजट दो वर्षों में क्रमिक भर्ती की अनुमति देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We made incremental big changes.
common_mistake.right: We made small, incremental changes.
common_mistake.why: incremental already means small steps; 'big' contradicts it

cloze.sentence: The team adopted an ____ migration plan, moving one service a week.

en_def: absolutely necessary; impossible to do without
hi_def: अपरिहार्य, अनिवार्य, जिसके बिना काम न चले
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'important'. Often about people: 'an indispensable member of the team'. Spelling: -able, not -ible.

examples.en: Good logging is indispensable for incident response.
examples.hi: अच्छी लॉगिंग घटना प्रतिक्रिया के लिए अपरिहार्य है।

examples.en: She has become indispensable to the project.
examples.hi: वह परियोजना के लिए अपरिहार्य बन गई है।

examples.en: A dictionary is an indispensable tool for a translator.
examples.hi: शब्दकोश अनुवादक के लिए एक अपरिहार्य उपकरण है।

examples.en: Nobody is truly indispensable; document your work.
examples.hi: कोई भी वास्तव में अपरिहार्य नहीं है; अपना काम दस्तावेज़ में लिखें।

examples.en: Trust is indispensable in any partnership.
examples.hi: किसी भी साझेदारी में विश्वास अपरिहार्य है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is indispensible for the team.
common_mistake.right: He is indispensable to the team.
common_mistake.why: spelling is -able, and the preposition is 'to'

cloze.sentence: Version control is ____ to modern software teams.

en_def: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
hi_def: अंतर्निहित, स्वाभाविक, मूल रूप से मौजूद
hi_nuance: Key phrase: 'inherent risk' (risk that exists before any controls). Learners say 'natural' or 'built-in'. Always 'inherent in'.

examples.en: There is an inherent risk in exposing any service to the internet.
examples.hi: किसी भी सेवा को इंटरनेट पर उजागर करने में अंतर्निहित जोखिम होता है।

examples.en: Uncertainty is inherent in every forecast.
examples.hi: हर पूर्वानुमान में अनिश्चितता अंतर्निहित है।

examples.en: The design has an inherent flaw that no patch can fix.
examples.hi: डिज़ाइन में एक अंतर्निहित दोष है जिसे कोई पैच ठीक नहीं कर सकता।

examples.en: Curiosity seems inherent in children.
examples.hi: जिज्ञासा बच्चों में स्वाभाविक रूप से मौजूद लगती है।

examples.en: The inherent complexity of the system slows down new hires.
examples.hi: सिस्टम की अंतर्निहित जटिलता नए कर्मचारियों को धीमा कर देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Risk is inherent to cloud computing.
common_mistake.right: Risk is inherent in cloud computing.
common_mistake.why: 'inherent in' is the standard preposition

cloze.sentence: Some latency is ____ in any system that spans two continents.

en_def: very complicated, with many small connected parts or details
hi_nuance: Positive or neutral, unlike 'complicated' which sounds negative. Used for designs, patterns, and systems. Stress on the first syllable: IN-tri-cate.

examples.en: The malware used an intricate series of steps to avoid detection.
examples.hi: मैलवेयर ने पहचान से बचने के लिए कदमों की एक जटिल श्रृंखला का उपयोग किया।

examples.en: The rug has an intricate pattern woven by hand.
examples.hi: गलीचे में हाथ से बुना हुआ एक बारीक पैटर्न है।

examples.en: Tax law is notoriously intricate.
examples.hi: कर कानून बदनाम रूप से पेचीदा है।

examples.en: The two systems are connected by an intricate web of dependencies.
examples.hi: दोनों सिस्टम निर्भरताओं के एक जटिल जाल से जुड़े हैं।

examples.en: The plot of the novel is intricate but rewarding.
examples.hi: उपन्यास की कथा जटिल है लेकिन सार्थक है।

common_mistake.wrong: The rules are very intricated.
common_mistake.right: The rules are very intricate.
common_mistake.why: 'intricate' is already an adjective; there is no verb 'intricate'

cloze.sentence: Untangling the ____ permissions model took the auditors a week.

en_def: very small in amount or effect; on the edge of what matters
hi_nuance: Learners think of 'margin' on a page. 'A marginal improvement' means barely noticeable. In economics 'marginal cost' has a technical meaning (cost of one more unit).

examples.en: The new index gave only a marginal improvement in query speed.
examples.hi: नए इंडेक्स से क्वेरी की गति में केवल मामूली सुधार हुआ।

examples.en: The party won by a marginal majority.
examples.hi: पार्टी ने मामूली बहुमत से जीत हासिल की।

examples.en: The marginal cost of adding one more user is close to zero.
examples.hi: एक और उपयोगकर्ता जोड़ने की सीमांत लागत लगभग शून्य है।

examples.en: Farming on such marginal land is barely profitable.
examples.hi: ऐसी सीमांत भूमि पर खेती मुश्किल से लाभदायक है।

examples.en: The difference between the two candidates was marginal.
examples.hi: दोनों उम्मीदवारों के बीच अंतर मामूली था।

common_mistake.wrong: The sales increased marginal.
common_mistake.right: Sales increased marginally.
common_mistake.why: use the adverb to modify the verb

cloze.sentence: Upgrading the CPU produced only a ____ gain in throughput.

en_def: done or shown openly, not hidden
hi_def: प्रत्यक्ष, खुला, स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाया गया
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'covert' (गुप्त). Learners rarely use it; 'overt hostility', 'overt discrimination' are the typical collocations.

examples.en: There was no overt hostility, but the tension was obvious.
examples.hi: कोई खुली शत्रुता नहीं थी, लेकिन तनाव स्पष्ट था।

examples.en: The company denies any overt discrimination in hiring.
examples.hi: कंपनी भर्ती में किसी भी प्रत्यक्ष भेदभाव से इनकार करती है।

examples.en: The scan was overt; the attackers did not try to hide it.
examples.hi: स्कैन खुला था; हमलावरों ने उसे छिपाने की कोशिश नहीं की।

examples.en: His support for the rival plan became overt at the meeting.
examples.hi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी योजना के लिए उसका समर्थन बैठक में खुलकर सामने आया।

examples.en: Overt surveillance is used as a deterrent in the car park.
examples.hi: कार पार्क में खुली निगरानी का उपयोग निवारक के रूप में किया जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He showed overt his anger.
common_mistake.right: He showed his anger overtly.
common_mistake.why: use the adverb after the verb phrase

cloze.sentence: The red team ran an ____ phishing test that staff were warned about.

en_def: more important than anything else
hi_nuance: Usually as a predicate: 'safety is paramount'. Learners say 'most important'; 'paramount' is the strong formal word for a single top priority. 'Of paramount importance' is a fixed phrase.

examples.en: During an incident, containing the breach is paramount.
examples.hi: किसी घटना के दौरान उल्लंघन को रोकना सर्वोपरि है।

examples.en: Customer trust is of paramount importance to us.
examples.hi: ग्राहक का भरोसा हमारे लिए सर्वोपरि महत्व का है।

examples.en: Patient safety must remain paramount.
examples.hi: रोगी की सुरक्षा सर्वोपरि रहनी चाहिए।

examples.en: Accuracy is paramount in a forensic report.
examples.hi: फ़ोरेंसिक रिपोर्ट में सटीकता सर्वोपरि है।

examples.en: The paramount concern is the welfare of the children.
examples.hi: सर्वोपरि चिंता बच्चों का कल्याण है।

common_mistake.wrong: Security is the most paramount thing.
common_mistake.right: Security is paramount.
common_mistake.why: paramount already means 'the most important'; 'most paramount' is redundant

cloze.sentence: When handling personal data, confidentiality is ____.

en_def: not safe or secure; likely to fall or fail
hi_nuance: Used for positions, finances, and jobs ('precarious employment'). Learners say 'risky' or 'unstable'. Four syllables: pre-CA-ri-ous.

examples.en: The company's finances are in a precarious state.
examples.hi: कंपनी की वित्तीय स्थिति डाँवाडोल है।

examples.en: He balanced the laptop precariously on the edge of the desk.
examples.hi: उसने लैपटॉप को डेस्क के किनारे पर डाँवाडोल तरीके से रखा।

examples.en: Gig workers often live in precarious conditions.
examples.hi: गिग कर्मचारी अक्सर अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में रहते हैं।

examples.en: Running production on a single server is precarious.
examples.hi: एक ही सर्वर पर प्रोडक्शन चलाना जोखिमपूर्ण है।

examples.en: The ceasefire remains precarious.
examples.hi: युद्धविराम अनिश्चित बना हुआ है।

common_mistake.wrong: The situation is very precarious for us to do.
common_mistake.right: The situation is very precarious for us.
common_mistake.why: precarious describes a state, not an action; drop 'to do'

cloze.sentence: With only one engineer who understands the system, the project is in a ____ position.

en_def: widespread or common at a particular time or place
hi_nuance: Learners say 'common'. 'Prevalent' is used in research and reports: 'a prevalent misconception', 'prevalent among young users'. Noun: prevalence.

examples.en: Credential stuffing is the most prevalent attack we see.
examples.hi: क्रेडेंशियल स्टफ़िंग सबसे प्रचलित हमला है जो हम देखते हैं।

examples.en: Such views were prevalent in the nineteenth century.
examples.hi: उन्नीसवीं सदी में ऐसे विचार प्रचलित थे।

examples.en: Password reuse is prevalent among employees.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों में पासवर्ड का दोबारा उपयोग आम है।

examples.en: The disease is more prevalent in tropical regions.
examples.hi: यह बीमारी उष्णकटिबंधीय क्षेत्रों में अधिक प्रचलित है।

examples.en: There is a prevalent misconception that HTTPS makes a site secure.
examples.hi: एक प्रचलित गलत धारणा है कि एचटीटीपीएस से साइट सुरक्षित हो जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Phishing is very prevalent in nowadays.
common_mistake.right: Phishing is very prevalent nowadays.
common_mistake.why: 'nowadays' is an adverb; no 'in'

cloze.sentence: Outdated software remains ____ in small businesses.

en_def: careful and sensible, avoiding unnecessary risk
hi_nuance: Positive; used for decisions and people. Learners say 'careful' or 'wise'. 'It would be prudent to...' is a polite way to recommend caution.

examples.en: It would be prudent to back up the database before the upgrade.
examples.hi: अपग्रेड से पहले डेटाबेस का बैकअप लेना विवेकपूर्ण होगा।

examples.en: A prudent investor never puts everything in one stock.
examples.hi: एक समझदार निवेशक कभी सब कुछ एक ही शेयर में नहीं लगाता।

examples.en: The board took the prudent step of delaying the launch.
examples.hi: बोर्ड ने लॉन्च को टालने का विवेकपूर्ण कदम उठाया।

examples.en: She is prudent with money.
examples.hi: वह पैसे के मामले में समझदार है।

examples.en: Prudent planning avoided a much larger loss.
examples.hi: विवेकपूर्ण योजना ने कहीं बड़े नुकसान से बचाया।

common_mistake.wrong: It is prudent that to wait.
common_mistake.right: It is prudent to wait.
common_mistake.why: 'prudent to + verb'; do not add 'that'

cloze.sentence: Given the uncertainty, the ____ course is to rotate all keys now.

en_def: not needed because it repeats something, or (of workers) dismissed because the job no longer exists
hi_nuance: Engineers use 'redundant' positively (redundant servers = backup). British English 'made redundant' means laid off. Learners mix these up; context decides.

examples.en: The second check is redundant because the first already validates the input.
examples.hi: दूसरी जाँच अनावश्यक है क्योंकि पहली ही इनपुट को सत्यापित कर देती है।

examples.en: Two hundred staff were made redundant when the plant closed.
examples.hi: संयंत्र बंद होने पर दो सौ कर्मचारियों की छँटनी कर दी गई।

examples.en: Redundant power supplies keep the server running if one fails.
examples.hi: अतिरिक्त बिजली आपूर्ति एक के विफल होने पर सर्वर को चालू रखती है।

examples.en: Cut the redundant phrases to make the report shorter.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट छोटी करने के लिए फ़ालतू वाक्यांश हटाएँ।

examples.en: 'Revert back' is redundant; 'revert' already means go back.
examples.hi: 'रिवर्ट बैक' फ़ालतू है; 'रिवर्ट' का अर्थ पहले से ही वापस जाना है।

common_mistake.wrong: The company redundanted fifty people.
common_mistake.right: The company made fifty people redundant.
common_mistake.why: 'redundant' is an adjective; use 'make someone redundant'

cloze.sentence: After automation, several manual steps became ____.

en_def: extremely thorough, careful, and strict
hi_nuance: Positive in academic and testing contexts: 'rigorous testing', 'rigorous analysis'. Learners say 'strict' (which sounds like a teacher) or 'deep'.

examples.en: All changes go through rigorous testing before release.
examples.hi: सभी बदलाव रिलीज़ से पहले कठोर परीक्षण से गुज़रते हैं।

examples.en: The study applied rigorous statistical methods.
examples.hi: अध्ययन ने कठोर सांख्यिकीय विधियों को लागू किया।

examples.en: Pilots undergo rigorous training.
examples.hi: पायलट कठोर प्रशिक्षण से गुज़रते हैं।

examples.en: The audit was rigorous and found several gaps.
examples.hi: ऑडिट सख़्त था और उसने कई खामियाँ पाईं।

examples.en: A rigorous definition of 'done' prevents half-finished work.
examples.hi: 'पूर्ण' की सख़्त परिभाषा अधूरे काम को रोकती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We tested the code rigorous.
common_mistake.right: We tested the code rigorously.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed after the verb

cloze.sentence: The vendor's claims did not survive ____ examination.

en_def: most noticeable or important
hi_nuance: Indian exam English overuses 'salient features'. Natives use 'salient' sparingly: 'the salient point is...'. In casual writing say 'key' or 'main'.

examples.en: The most salient finding was that no one had reviewed the firewall rules.
examples.hi: सबसे प्रमुख निष्कर्ष यह था कि किसी ने भी फ़ायरवॉल नियमों की समीक्षा नहीं की थी।

examples.en: She summarised the salient points in one slide.
examples.hi: उसने मुख्य बिंदुओं को एक स्लाइड में संक्षेप में बताया।

examples.en: The salient difference between the two plans is price.
examples.hi: दोनों योजनाओं के बीच प्रमुख अंतर कीमत है।

examples.en: Colour is the most salient feature of the new design.
examples.hi: रंग नए डिज़ाइन की सबसे उल्लेखनीय विशेषता है।

examples.en: Only the salient facts appear in the executive summary.
examples.hi: कार्यकारी सारांश में केवल प्रमुख तथ्य ही दिखाई देते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly note the salient features of the product as follows.
common_mistake.right: Here are the key features of the product.
common_mistake.why: the Indian formula is heavy; 'key' is natural in product writing

cloze.sentence: The report opens with the three most ____ risks.

en_def: insufficient for the demand; hard to find
hi_nuance: Used for resources: water, skills, time. Learners confuse the adverb 'scarcely' (hardly, मुश्किल से) with 'scarce'. Also 'scarce' is not 'scared'.

examples.en: Skilled security engineers are scarce, so salaries are high.
examples.hi: कुशल सुरक्षा इंजीनियर दुर्लभ हैं, इसलिए वेतन ऊँचे हैं।

examples.en: Water becomes scarce in the dry season.
examples.hi: शुष्क मौसम में पानी दुर्लभ हो जाता है।

examples.en: Time was scarce, so we prioritised the critical fixes.
examples.hi: समय कम था, इसलिए हमने महत्वपूर्ण सुधारों को प्राथमिकता दी।

examples.en: Reliable data on the outbreak is scarce.
examples.hi: प्रकोप पर विश्वसनीय डेटा दुर्लभ है।

examples.en: Parking is scarce near the office.
examples.hi: कार्यालय के पास पार्किंग कम है।

common_mistake.wrong: Jobs are scarcely in this town.
common_mistake.right: Jobs are scarce in this town.
common_mistake.why: 'scarcely' means hardly; use the adjective 'scarce'

cloze.sentence: When memory is ____, the system starts swapping to disk.

en_def: (of rules or conditions) very strict and demanding
hi_nuance: Only for rules, checks, and requirements, never for people (a teacher is strict, not stringent). Typical: 'stringent security checks', 'stringent requirements'.

examples.en: Banks must meet stringent security requirements.
examples.hi: बैंकों को कड़ी सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना होगा।

examples.en: The new regulations are far more stringent than the old ones.
examples.hi: नए नियम पुराने नियमों से कहीं अधिक कड़े हैं।

examples.en: Airports have introduced more stringent checks.
examples.hi: हवाई अड्डों ने और कड़ी जाँच शुरू की है।

examples.en: Stringent testing delayed the release by two weeks.
examples.hi: कड़े परीक्षण ने रिलीज़ में दो सप्ताह की देरी की।

examples.en: The contract sets stringent conditions on data handling.
examples.hi: अनुबंध डेटा प्रबंधन पर कड़ी शर्तें निर्धारित करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My manager is very stringent.
common_mistake.right: My manager is very strict.
common_mistake.why: stringent describes rules and conditions, not people

cloze.sentence: Medical devices are subject to ____ safety standards.

en_def: only on the surface; not thorough or deep
hi_nuance: Critical in reviews: 'a superficial analysis'. Also for injuries (superficial wound) and people (shallow). Learners say 'not deep' or 'only outside'.

examples.en: The audit was superficial and missed the real weaknesses.
examples.hi: ऑडिट सतही था और उसने असली कमज़ोरियों को छोड़ दिया।

examples.en: He has only a superficial understanding of cryptography.
examples.hi: उसे क्रिप्टोग्राफ़ी की केवल सतही समझ है।

examples.en: The damage to the car was superficial.
examples.hi: कार को हुआ नुकसान ऊपरी था।

examples.en: The two products have a superficial resemblance.
examples.hi: दोनों उत्पादों में सतही समानता है।

examples.en: Do not judge the fix on a superficial reading of the diff.
examples.hi: डिफ़ की सतही पढ़ाई के आधार पर सुधार का मूल्यांकन न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: They checked the code superficial.
common_mistake.right: They checked the code superficially.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed to modify the verb

cloze.sentence: A ____ scan will not find logic flaws in the payment flow.

en_def: likely to be influenced or harmed by something
hi_def: संवेदनशील, प्रभावित होने योग्य, आसानी से शिकार बनने वाला
hi_nuance: Always 'susceptible to'. Learners say 'prone to' (fine) or 'weak to' (wrong). In security: 'susceptible to injection'.

examples.en: Older browsers are susceptible to this attack.
examples.hi: पुराने ब्राउज़र इस हमले के प्रति संवेदनशील हैं।

examples.en: Children are more susceptible to infection.
examples.hi: बच्चे संक्रमण के प्रति अधिक संवेदनशील होते हैं।

examples.en: The region is susceptible to flooding.
examples.hi: यह क्षेत्र बाढ़ के प्रति संवेदनशील है।

examples.en: Tired staff are more susceptible to phishing.
examples.hi: थके हुए कर्मचारी फ़िशिंग का आसानी से शिकार बनते हैं।

examples.en: The forecast is highly susceptible to changes in oil prices.
examples.hi: पूर्वानुमान तेल की कीमतों में बदलाव से अत्यधिक प्रभावित होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The app is susceptible for SQL injection.
common_mistake.right: The app is susceptible to SQL injection.
common_mistake.why: susceptible always takes 'to'

cloze.sentence: Unpatched systems are especially ____ to ransomware.

en_def: real and able to be seen, touched, or measured
hi_nuance: Learners say 'real' or 'solid'. 'Tangible results/benefits' is the business phrase for outcomes you can measure. Opposite: intangible (goodwill, brand).

examples.en: The training produced tangible improvements in response times.
examples.hi: प्रशिक्षण से प्रतिक्रिया समय में ठोस सुधार हुए।

examples.en: We need tangible evidence, not just a suspicion.
examples.hi: हमें ठोस सबूत चाहिए, केवल संदेह नहीं।

examples.en: There are no tangible benefits yet, but morale has improved.
examples.hi: अभी कोई ठोस लाभ नहीं है, लेकिन मनोबल में सुधार हुआ है।

examples.en: Brand reputation is an intangible asset.
examples.hi: ब्रांड प्रतिष्ठा एक अमूर्त संपत्ति है।

examples.en: The tension in the room was almost tangible.
examples.hi: कमरे में तनाव लगभग महसूस किया जा सकता था।

common_mistake.wrong: We saw tangible progress in visible.
common_mistake.right: We saw tangible progress.
common_mistake.why: 'tangible' already means visible or measurable

cloze.sentence: Management wants ____ proof that the new tool reduced incidents.

en_def: likely to change suddenly and unpredictably, often for the worse
hi_nuance: Used for markets, situations, and tempers. Programmers know the 'volatile' keyword and 'volatile memory'. British pronunciation ends in /-taɪl/, American in /-təl/.

examples.en: Cryptocurrency prices are extremely volatile.
examples.hi: क्रिप्टोकरेंसी की कीमतें बेहद अस्थिर हैं।

examples.en: The political situation remains volatile.
examples.hi: राजनीतिक स्थिति अस्थिर बनी हुई है।

examples.en: He has a volatile temper.
examples.hi: उसका मिज़ाज बहुत अस्थिर है।

examples.en: Data in volatile memory is lost when the power goes off.
examples.hi: अस्थिर मेमोरी का डेटा बिजली जाने पर खो जाता है।

examples.en: Forecasting is hard in such a volatile market.
examples.hi: इतने अस्थिर बाज़ार में पूर्वानुमान लगाना कठिन है।

common_mistake.wrong: The share price is very volatility.
common_mistake.right: The share price is very volatile.
common_mistake.why: 'volatility' is the noun; use the adjective after 'is'

cloze.sentence: Threat intelligence goes stale quickly in such a ____ environment.

en_def: treating all sides equally; not favouring one
hi_nuance: Learners say 'neutral' or 'unbiased'. 'Impartial' is the word for judges, referees, auditors, and advice. Do not confuse with 'partial' (adj. incomplete, or 'partial to' = fond of).

examples.en: An impartial third party will review the complaint.
examples.hi: एक निष्पक्ष तीसरा पक्ष शिकायत की समीक्षा करेगा।

examples.en: The referee must remain impartial at all times.
examples.hi: रेफ़री को हर समय निष्पक्ष रहना चाहिए।

examples.en: We hired external auditors for an impartial assessment.
examples.hi: हमने निष्पक्ष आकलन के लिए बाहरी ऑडिटरों को नियुक्त किया।

examples.en: It is hard to be impartial about your own code.
examples.hi: अपने ही कोड के बारे में निष्पक्ष होना कठिन है।

examples.en: The report offers impartial advice on choosing a vendor.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट विक्रेता चुनने पर निष्पक्ष सलाह देती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The judge was partial to both sides equally.
common_mistake.right: The judge was impartial.
common_mistake.why: 'partial to' means fond of; the word for fairness is 'impartial'

cloze.sentence: Post-mortems need an ____ facilitator who was not on call.

en_def: necessary to make a whole complete; essential
hi_nuance: Always 'integral to' or 'an integral part of'. Learners write 'integral for'. Stress on the first syllable in this sense: IN-te-gral.

examples.en: Logging is an integral part of the security architecture.
examples.hi: लॉगिंग सुरक्षा वास्तुकला का एक अभिन्न हिस्सा है।

examples.en: She has been integral to the project's success.
examples.hi: वह परियोजना की सफलता के लिए अभिन्न रही है।

examples.en: Music is integral to the culture of the region.
examples.hi: संगीत इस क्षेत्र की संस्कृति का अभिन्न अंग है।

examples.en: Testing should be integral to development, not an afterthought.
examples.hi: परीक्षण विकास का अभिन्न हिस्सा होना चाहिए, बाद का विचार नहीं।

examples.en: The camera is integral to the phone's design.
examples.hi: कैमरा फ़ोन के डिज़ाइन का अभिन्न हिस्सा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Feedback is integral for learning.
common_mistake.right: Feedback is integral to learning.
common_mistake.why: integral takes 'to'

cloze.sentence: Threat modelling is ____ to the design phase, not a final check.

en_def: no longer used or useful because something newer exists
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'outdated' (behind the times). Obsolete means replaced and no longer used. Learners say 'old' or 'expired'.

examples.en: The legacy system is obsolete and no longer receives patches.
examples.hi: पुराना सिस्टम अप्रचलित है और अब पैच प्राप्त नहीं करता।

examples.en: Fax machines are almost obsolete in most offices.
examples.hi: अधिकांश कार्यालयों में फ़ैक्स मशीनें लगभग अप्रचलित हो चुकी हैं।

examples.en: The new standard renders the old cipher obsolete.
examples.hi: नया मानक पुराने सिफर को अप्रचलित बना देता है।

examples.en: His skills became obsolete when the industry changed.
examples.hi: उद्योग बदलने पर उसके कौशल अप्रचलित हो गए।

examples.en: Planned obsolescence forces customers to upgrade.
examples.hi: नियोजित अप्रचलन ग्राहकों को अपग्रेड करने के लिए मजबूर करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This software is expired.
common_mistake.right: This software is obsolete.
common_mistake.why: 'expired' is for licences and dates; software that nobody uses is obsolete

cloze.sentence: SHA-1 is ____ and must not be used for new signatures.

en_def: very great or intense; showing deep understanding
hi_nuance: Learners say 'very deep' or 'very big'. 'Profound effect/impact/change' are the key collocations. Do not use for physical depth (a profound well is wrong).

examples.en: The breach had a profound effect on how the company handles data.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन का इस बात पर गहरा प्रभाव पड़ा कि कंपनी डेटा कैसे संभालती है।

examples.en: She has a profound understanding of the codebase.
examples.hi: उसे कोडबेस की गहन समझ है।

examples.en: The discovery had profound implications for medicine.
examples.hi: इस खोज के चिकित्सा के लिए गहरे निहितार्थ थे।

examples.en: There is a profound difference between hearing and listening.
examples.hi: सुनने और ध्यान से सुनने में गहरा अंतर है।

examples.en: The news came as a profound shock.
examples.hi: यह खबर एक गहरे सदमे के रूप में आई।

common_mistake.wrong: The lake is very profound.
common_mistake.right: The lake is very deep.
common_mistake.why: profound is for abstract depth, not physical

cloze.sentence: Remote work has had a ____ impact on office culture.

en_def: happening occasionally and irregularly
hi_nuance: Learners say 'sometimes' or 'random'. 'Sporadic' describes events with no pattern: sporadic errors, sporadic attendance. Useful in bug reports.

examples.en: Users reported sporadic timeouts that we could not reproduce.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं ने छिटपुट टाइमआउट की सूचना दी जिन्हें हम दोहरा नहीं सके।

examples.en: There has been sporadic fighting along the border.
examples.hi: सीमा पर छिटपुट लड़ाई होती रही है।

examples.en: His attendance at meetings is sporadic.
examples.hi: बैठकों में उसकी उपस्थिति अनियमित है।

examples.en: Sporadic rain is expected over the weekend.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत में छिटपुट बारिश की उम्मीद है।

examples.en: The failures were sporadic rather than constant.
examples.hi: विफलताएँ लगातार नहीं, बल्कि छिटपुट थीं।

common_mistake.wrong: The bug happens sporadic.
common_mistake.right: The bug happens sporadically.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed after the verb

cloze.sentence: The ____ nature of the crash made it hard to capture a stack trace.

en_def: not obvious; small but important or clever
hi_nuance: The 'b' is silent: /ˈsʌtl/. Indian speakers often pronounce it. 'A subtle difference/change/hint' are the main collocations.

examples.en: There is a subtle difference between 'affect' and 'effect'.
examples.hi: 'affect' और 'effect' में एक सूक्ष्म अंतर है।

examples.en: The bug was caused by a subtle change in the time-zone handling.
examples.hi: बग समय-क्षेत्र प्रबंधन में एक सूक्ष्म बदलाव के कारण हुआ था।

examples.en: She dropped a subtle hint that she wanted to leave early.
examples.hi: उसने एक हल्का संकेत दिया कि वह जल्दी जाना चाहती है।

examples.en: The colours are subtle rather than bright.
examples.hi: रंग चमकीले नहीं, बल्कि हल्के हैं।

examples.en: Subtle signs of an intrusion are easy to miss.
examples.hi: घुसपैठ के सूक्ष्म संकेत आसानी से छूट जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: He changed it subtle.
common_mistake.right: He changed it subtly.
common_mistake.why: an adverb is needed to modify the verb

cloze.sentence: The phishing email had only ____ signs that it was fake.

en_def: harmful, unfavourable, or working against something
hi_nuance: Confused with 'averse' (opposed to: 'risk-averse'). 'Adverse effects/conditions/weather' are the collocations. Stress: AD-verse in British English.

examples.en: The drug has few adverse effects.
examples.hi: इस दवा के बहुत कम प्रतिकूल प्रभाव हैं।

examples.en: Flights were cancelled because of adverse weather.
examples.hi: प्रतिकूल मौसम के कारण उड़ानें रद्द कर दी गईं।

examples.en: The change had an adverse impact on performance.
examples.hi: इस बदलाव का प्रदर्शन पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पड़ा।

examples.en: Adverse publicity forced the company to apologise.
examples.hi: प्रतिकूल प्रचार ने कंपनी को माफ़ी माँगने पर मजबूर किया।

examples.en: Any adverse findings must be reported within 24 hours.
examples.hi: किसी भी प्रतिकूल निष्कर्ष की सूचना 24 घंटे के भीतर देनी होगी।

common_mistake.wrong: The board is adverse to risk.
common_mistake.right: The board is averse to risk.
common_mistake.why: averse = opposed to; adverse = harmful

cloze.sentence: The outage had an ____ effect on customer confidence.

en_def: a difference between two things that should be the same
hi_nuance: Learners say 'mismatch' or 'difference'. 'Discrepancy' is the audit and finance word: 'a discrepancy between the invoice and the receipt'. Plural: discrepancies.

examples.en: Auditors found a discrepancy between the reported and actual figures.
examples.hi: ऑडिटरों ने रिपोर्ट किए गए और वास्तविक आँकड़ों के बीच विसंगति पाई।

examples.en: There is a discrepancy in the log timestamps that needs explaining.
examples.hi: लॉग टाइमस्टैम्प में एक विसंगति है जिसे समझाने की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: Please investigate any discrepancies in the inventory count.
examples.hi: कृपया इन्वेंटरी गिनती में किसी भी विसंगति की जाँच करें।

examples.en: The discrepancy was traced to a rounding error.
examples.hi: विसंगति का कारण एक राउंडिंग त्रुटि पाया गया।

examples.en: Minor discrepancies between the two reports are to be expected.
examples.hi: दोनों रिपोर्टों के बीच मामूली विसंगतियाँ अपेक्षित हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a discrepancy of the two figures.
common_mistake.right: There is a discrepancy between the two figures.
common_mistake.why: use 'between' for two things and 'in' for a single set

cloze.sentence: The ____ between the hash values proved the file had been altered.

en_def: a complicated or unwelcome consequence of an action, often one of several
hi_nuance: Almost always plural: 'the ramifications of'. Learners say 'consequences' or 'effects'; 'ramifications' stresses that the effects spread out in many directions and were not planned.

examples.en: The legal ramifications of the breach could last for years.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन के कानूनी परिणाम वर्षों तक रह सकते हैं।

examples.en: Nobody considered the ramifications of removing the rate limit.
examples.hi: किसी ने दर सीमा हटाने के दूरगामी प्रभावों पर विचार नहीं किया।

examples.en: The decision had ramifications for every department.
examples.hi: निर्णय का हर विभाग पर असर पड़ा।

examples.en: We need to think through the ramifications before we announce anything.
examples.hi: कुछ भी घोषित करने से पहले हमें परिणामों पर पूरी तरह विचार करना होगा।

examples.en: The ruling has wide ramifications for data privacy.
examples.hi: इस फ़ैसले के डेटा गोपनीयता पर व्यापक प्रभाव हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The ramification of the bug was that we lost data.
common_mistake.right: One ramification of the bug was that we lost data.
common_mistake.why: ramifications are usually several; single one needs 'one' or use 'consequence'

cloze.sentence: The ____ of storing passwords in plain text went far beyond one system.

en_def: a warning that a statement has limits or conditions
hi_nuance: Pronounced /ˈkæviæt/, not 'cave-at'. Very useful in reports: 'with one caveat', 'the usual caveats apply'. Learners say 'but note that', which is fine but less crisp.

examples.en: The tool is fast, with one caveat: it does not handle Unicode.
examples.hi: यह टूल तेज़ है, एक शर्त के साथ: यह यूनिकोड को नहीं संभालता।

examples.en: The usual caveats about sample size apply to these results.
examples.hi: नमूना आकार के बारे में सामान्य चेतावनियाँ इन परिणामों पर लागू होती हैं।

examples.en: I would add a caveat that the numbers are preliminary.
examples.hi: मैं यह चेतावनी जोड़ूँगा कि आँकड़े प्रारंभिक हैं।

examples.en: The advice comes with a caveat: test it in staging first.
examples.hi: सलाह एक शर्त के साथ है: इसे पहले स्टेजिंग में जाँचें।

examples.en: There is an important caveat to the vendor's claim.
examples.hi: विक्रेता के दावे पर एक महत्वपूर्ण चेतावनी है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a caveat of this approach.
common_mistake.right: There is a caveat to this approach.
common_mistake.why: 'caveat to' is the usual pattern

cloze.sentence: The scan results are reliable, with the ____ that only port 443 was tested.

en_def: an earlier event or decision that serves as an example or rule for later ones
hi_nuance: Sounds like 'president' but is /ˈpresɪdənt/ with an s. 'Set a precedent' is the key phrase; managers use it to refuse exceptions ('that would set a precedent').

examples.en: Granting this exception would set a dangerous precedent.
examples.hi: यह अपवाद देना एक ख़तरनाक मिसाल कायम करेगा।

examples.en: There is no precedent for a fine of this size.
examples.hi: इतने बड़े जुर्माने की कोई मिसाल नहीं है।

examples.en: The court followed the precedent set in 2015.
examples.hi: अदालत ने 2015 में स्थापित नज़ीर का पालन किया।

examples.en: Her promotion set a precedent for other engineers without degrees.
examples.hi: उसकी पदोन्नति ने बिना डिग्री वाले अन्य इंजीनियरों के लिए एक मिसाल कायम की।

examples.en: We broke with precedent and published the full incident report.
examples.hi: हमने परंपरा तोड़ी और पूरी घटना रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित की।

common_mistake.wrong: This will make a precedent.
common_mistake.right: This will set a precedent.
common_mistake.why: the verb is 'set'

cloze.sentence: Paying the ransom would set a ____ that attackers could exploit again.

en_def: the power to influence people or situations; (verb) to use something to maximum advantage
hi_def: प्रभाव डालने की शक्ति, लाभ उठाना
hi_nuance: Business jargon as a verb ('leverage our strengths'); native speakers sometimes mock it, so use 'use' in plain writing. The noun sense (influence, दबाव बनाने की शक्ति) is safe.

examples.en: The union has little leverage in the negotiations.
examples.hi: वार्ता में यूनियन के पास बहुत कम प्रभाव है।

examples.en: Attackers leveraged a stolen token to reach the internal API.
examples.hi: हमलावरों ने आंतरिक एपीआई तक पहुँचने के लिए चुराए गए टोकन का लाभ उठाया।

examples.en: We can leverage the existing monitoring instead of building new tools.
examples.hi: हम नए टूल बनाने के बजाय मौजूदा निगरानी का लाभ उठा सकते हैं।

examples.en: Owning the patent gives the company enormous leverage.
examples.hi: पेटेंट का स्वामित्व कंपनी को भारी प्रभाव देता है।

examples.en: They used the deadline as leverage to get a discount.
examples.hi: उन्होंने छूट पाने के लिए समय-सीमा को दबाव के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया।

common_mistake.wrong: We will leverage on our partners.
common_mistake.right: We will leverage our partners' expertise.
common_mistake.why: leverage as a verb is transitive; no 'on'

cloze.sentence: Because the vendor had no other customers, we had considerable ____ on price.

en_def: the state of having more than one possible meaning
hi_nuance: The noun of 'ambiguous'. Learners say 'confusion'. In requirements and legal work 'remove the ambiguity' is the standard phrase.

examples.en: The ambiguity in the spec led to two incompatible implementations.
examples.hi: स्पेक की अस्पष्टता ने दो असंगत कार्यान्वयन पैदा किए।

examples.en: There is some ambiguity about who owns the decision.
examples.hi: इस बारे में कुछ अस्पष्टता है कि निर्णय का मालिक कौन है।

examples.en: Good policies leave no room for ambiguity.
examples.hi: अच्छी नीतियाँ अस्पष्टता के लिए कोई जगह नहीं छोड़तीं।

examples.en: Poets use ambiguity deliberately.
examples.hi: कवि जानबूझकर दोअर्थीपन का उपयोग करते हैं।

examples.en: We rewrote the clause to remove any ambiguity.
examples.hi: हमने किसी भी अस्पष्टता को दूर करने के लिए खंड को फिर से लिखा।

common_mistake.wrong: There is an ambiguous in the text.
common_mistake.right: There is an ambiguity in the text.
common_mistake.why: after 'an' a noun is needed

cloze.sentence: The word 'shortly' introduces ____ into the deadline.

en_def: something that differs from what is normal or expected
hi_nuance: Security people know 'anomaly detection'. Plural: anomalies. Learners say 'abnormal thing'. Adjective: anomalous.

examples.en: The monitoring system flagged an anomaly in outbound traffic at 3 a.m.
examples.hi: निगरानी प्रणाली ने सुबह 3 बजे आउटबाउंड ट्रैफ़िक में एक असामान्यता को चिह्नित किया।

examples.en: The data contains several anomalies that need investigating.
examples.hi: डेटा में कई विसंगतियाँ हैं जिनकी जाँच आवश्यक है।

examples.en: A warm day in January is an anomaly, not a trend.
examples.hi: जनवरी में गर्म दिन एक अपवाद है, प्रवृत्ति नहीं।

examples.en: The anomaly turned out to be a misconfigured sensor.
examples.hi: असामान्यता एक गलत कॉन्फ़िगर किए गए सेंसर के कारण निकली।

examples.en: Anomaly detection models learn what 'normal' looks like.
examples.hi: विसंगति पहचान मॉडल सीखते हैं कि 'सामान्य' कैसा दिखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We saw an anomalous in the logs.
common_mistake.right: We saw an anomaly in the logs.
common_mistake.why: 'anomalous' is the adjective; the noun is 'anomaly'

cloze.sentence: A sudden spike in failed logins is the kind of ____ worth investigating.

en_def: a standard against which things can be measured or compared
hi_nuance: Also a verb: 'benchmark our performance against competitors'. Learners use 'standard'; 'benchmark' implies measurement and comparison.

examples.en: The report uses the industry average as a benchmark.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट उद्योग औसत को बेंचमार्क के रूप में उपयोग करती है।

examples.en: We benchmarked the new server against the old one.
examples.hi: हमने नए सर्वर की तुलना पुराने सर्वर से की।

examples.en: Her work sets the benchmark for the rest of the team.
examples.hi: उसका काम बाकी टीम के लिए मानक तय करता है।

examples.en: The CIS benchmarks describe secure configuration settings.
examples.hi: सीआईएस बेंचमार्क सुरक्षित कॉन्फ़िगरेशन सेटिंग्स का वर्णन करते हैं।

examples.en: Response time is the key benchmark for the support team.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया समय सहायता टीम के लिए मुख्य मानक है।

common_mistake.wrong: We benchmarked with the competitors.
common_mistake.right: We benchmarked ourselves against the competitors.
common_mistake.why: benchmark takes an object and 'against'

cloze.sentence: Last year's uptime of 99.95% is now the ____ for the whole company.

en_def: a connection between two things in which one changes as the other does
hi_nuance: 'Correlation is not causation' is a phrase every analyst should know. Preposition: 'correlation between X and Y'. Learners write 'correlation of X with Y', which is acceptable but less common.

examples.en: There is a strong correlation between sleep and exam performance.
examples.hi: नींद और परीक्षा प्रदर्शन के बीच एक मज़बूत सहसंबंध है।

examples.en: Correlation does not imply causation.
examples.hi: सहसंबंध का अर्थ कार्य-कारण नहीं होता।

examples.en: We found no correlation between team size and bug count.
examples.hi: हमें टीम के आकार और बग की संख्या के बीच कोई सहसंबंध नहीं मिला।

examples.en: The SIEM correlates events from several sources.
examples.hi: एसआईईएम कई स्रोतों से घटनाओं को सहसंबंधित करता है।

examples.en: The correlation was weak but statistically significant.
examples.hi: सहसंबंध कमज़ोर था लेकिन सांख्यिकीय रूप से महत्वपूर्ण था।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a correlation among speed and errors.
common_mistake.right: There is a correlation between speed and errors.
common_mistake.why: use 'between' for two items

cloze.sentence: The analyst found a clear ____ between patch delays and incident counts.

en_def: a standard by which something is judged or decided
hi_nuance: Singular 'criterion', plural 'criteria'. Learners say 'a criteria' or 'criterias'; both are wrong. 'Meet the criteria' is the common verb.

examples.en: Cost is only one criterion for choosing a vendor.
examples.hi: लागत विक्रेता चुनने का केवल एक मानदंड है।

examples.en: The candidate meets all the criteria for the role.
examples.hi: उम्मीदवार भूमिका के सभी मानदंडों को पूरा करता है।

examples.en: What criteria did you use to rank the risks?
examples.hi: जोखिमों को रैंक करने के लिए आपने किन मानदंडों का उपयोग किया?

examples.en: Exploitability is the main criterion for severity.
examples.hi: शोषण की संभावना गंभीरता का मुख्य मानदंड है।

examples.en: The selection criteria are published on the website.
examples.hi: चयन मानदंड वेबसाइट पर प्रकाशित हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is the most important criteria.
common_mistake.right: This is the most important criterion.
common_mistake.why: 'criteria' is plural; the singular is 'criterion'

cloze.sentence: The key ____ for closing a finding is proof that the fix was tested.

en_def: a departure from what is normal, expected, or planned
hi_nuance: Statistics: 'standard deviation'. Compliance: 'any deviation from the procedure must be logged'. Preposition: 'deviation from'. Verb: deviate.

examples.en: Any deviation from the approved process must be documented.
examples.hi: स्वीकृत प्रक्रिया से किसी भी विचलन को दस्तावेज़ में दर्ज करना होगा।

examples.en: The results show little deviation from last year's figures.
examples.hi: परिणाम पिछले वर्ष के आँकड़ों से बहुत कम विचलन दिखाते हैं।

examples.en: A low standard deviation means the values are close together.
examples.hi: कम मानक विचलन का अर्थ है कि मान एक-दूसरे के करीब हैं।

examples.en: The flight path showed a slight deviation to the north.
examples.hi: उड़ान पथ में उत्तर की ओर हल्का विचलन दिखा।

examples.en: We deviated from the plan when the vendor missed the deadline.
examples.hi: जब विक्रेता ने समय-सीमा चूकी तो हम योजना से हट गए।

common_mistake.wrong: There was a deviation of the plan.
common_mistake.right: There was a deviation from the plan.
common_mistake.why: deviation takes 'from'

cloze.sentence: The auditor noted a ____ from the documented change process.

en_def: a difficult choice between two or more options, none of which is fully satisfactory
hi_nuance: Not just 'a problem': a dilemma has two bad choices. Learners say 'confusion' (which is a state of mind). 'Face a dilemma', 'in a dilemma'.

examples.en: We face a dilemma: patch now and risk downtime, or wait and risk exploitation.
examples.hi: हम एक दुविधा में हैं: अभी पैच करें और डाउनटाइम का जोखिम लें, या प्रतीक्षा करें और शोषण का जोखिम लें।

examples.en: The doctor faced an ethical dilemma.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर के सामने एक नैतिक दुविधा थी।

examples.en: Her dilemma was whether to report her colleague.
examples.hi: उसकी दुविधा यह थी कि अपने सहकर्मी की रिपोर्ट करे या नहीं।

examples.en: The classic dilemma is speed versus security.
examples.hi: क्लासिक दुविधा है गति बनाम सुरक्षा।

examples.en: He resolved the dilemma by asking for more time.
examples.hi: उसने और समय माँगकर दुविधा को हल किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am in dilemma about the job.
common_mistake.right: I am in a dilemma about the job.
common_mistake.why: dilemma is countable; it needs an article

cloze.sentence: The team's ____ was whether to disclose the flaw before a fix was ready.

en_def: the freedom to decide what should be done; also, care in keeping things private
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'at the manager's discretion' (their choice) and 'handle with discretion' (quietly). Learners confuse it with 'discreet' (careful) and 'discrete' (separate).

examples.en: Bonuses are paid at the discretion of the board.
examples.hi: बोनस बोर्ड के विवेक पर दिया जाता है।

examples.en: Use your discretion when deciding which alerts to escalate.
examples.hi: यह तय करते समय अपने विवेक का उपयोग करें कि किन अलर्ट को आगे बढ़ाना है।

examples.en: The matter was handled with great discretion.
examples.hi: मामले को बड़ी गोपनीयता से संभाला गया।

examples.en: Managers have some discretion over working hours.
examples.hi: प्रबंधकों के पास काम के घंटों पर कुछ विवेकाधिकार है।

examples.en: Viewer discretion is advised.
examples.hi: दर्शकों को विवेक से देखने की सलाह दी जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: It is on the discretion of the manager.
common_mistake.right: It is at the discretion of the manager.
common_mistake.why: the fixed phrase is 'at the discretion of'

cloze.sentence: Whether to grant a deadline extension is at the reviewer's ____.

en_def: a large and often unfair difference between two things
hi_nuance: Learners say 'difference' or 'gap'. 'Disparity' implies the gap is significant and usually unjust: pay disparity, regional disparities. Preposition: 'disparity between/in'.

examples.en: There is a wide disparity between the salaries of the two roles.
examples.hi: दोनों भूमिकाओं के वेतन में बड़ा अंतर है।

examples.en: The report highlights regional disparities in internet access.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट इंटरनेट पहुँच में क्षेत्रीय असमानताओं को उजागर करती है।

examples.en: The disparity in test coverage between the two modules is striking.
examples.hi: दोनों मॉड्यूल के बीच परीक्षण कवरेज में असमानता चौंकाने वाली है।

examples.en: Income disparity has grown over the last decade.
examples.hi: पिछले दशक में आय असमानता बढ़ी है।

examples.en: We are working to reduce the disparity in response times.
examples.hi: हम प्रतिक्रिया समय में असमानता को कम करने पर काम कर रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There is disparity of the two teams' budgets.
common_mistake.right: There is a disparity between the two teams' budgets.
common_mistake.why: countable noun with 'between'

cloze.sentence: The ____ between the promised and actual uptime was hard to explain.

en_def: a likely consequence; or something suggested without being said directly
hi_nuance: Two senses: 'the implications of the decision' (consequences) and 'the implication was that I was lazy' (unspoken suggestion). Usually plural for the first sense.

examples.en: The new law has serious implications for data storage.
examples.hi: नए कानून के डेटा भंडारण के लिए गंभीर निहितार्थ हैं।

examples.en: The implication of his remark was that we had been careless.
examples.hi: उसकी टिप्पणी का निहितार्थ यह था कि हम लापरवाह थे।

examples.en: We need to understand the security implications before enabling the feature.
examples.hi: फ़ीचर सक्षम करने से पहले हमें सुरक्षा निहितार्थ समझने होंगे।

examples.en: By implication, the vendor accepted responsibility.
examples.hi: अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से, विक्रेता ने ज़िम्मेदारी स्वीकार की।

examples.en: The financial implications were not discussed.
examples.hi: वित्तीय परिणामों पर चर्चा नहीं की गई।

common_mistake.wrong: This has big implications on our plan.
common_mistake.right: This has big implications for our plan.
common_mistake.why: 'implications for' is the standard pattern

cloze.sentence: Moving to a new cloud region has ____ for data-residency rules.

en_def: the fact of not being the same throughout, or of contradicting something
hi_nuance: Learners say 'mismatch' or 'contradiction'. 'Inconsistency' covers both differences within one thing (inconsistent formatting) and contradictions between things (inconsistencies in the story).

examples.en: There are several inconsistencies in the witness's statement.
examples.hi: गवाह के बयान में कई असंगतियाँ हैं।

examples.en: Inconsistency in naming makes the code hard to read.
examples.hi: नामकरण में असंगति कोड को पढ़ना कठिन बना देती है।

examples.en: The audit noted inconsistencies between the policy and actual practice.
examples.hi: ऑडिट ने नीति और वास्तविक व्यवहार के बीच असंगतियों को नोट किया।

examples.en: Fix the inconsistency between the two date formats.
examples.hi: दोनों तिथि प्रारूपों के बीच की असंगति को ठीक करें।

examples.en: His main weakness as a player is inconsistency.
examples.hi: खिलाड़ी के रूप में उसकी मुख्य कमज़ोरी असंगति है।

common_mistake.wrong: The report has some inconsistent.
common_mistake.right: The report has some inconsistencies.
common_mistake.why: a noun is needed after 'some'

cloze.sentence: The ____ between the two logs suggested one had been edited.

en_def: a conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning
hi_nuance: The noun of 'infer'. 'Draw an inference' is the verb phrase. Learners say 'guess', which sounds unscientific; an inference is reasoned.

examples.en: The obvious inference is that the credentials were phished.
examples.hi: स्पष्ट अनुमान यह है कि क्रेडेंशियल फ़िश किए गए थे।

examples.en: Readers can draw their own inferences from the data.
examples.hi: पाठक डेटा से अपने निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं।

examples.en: Statistical inference lets us generalise from a sample.
examples.hi: सांख्यिकीय अनुमान हमें नमूने से सामान्यीकरण करने देता है।

examples.en: That is an inference, not a fact; label it as such in the report.
examples.hi: यह एक अनुमान है, तथ्य नहीं; रिपोर्ट में इसे वैसा ही लिखें।

examples.en: Machine-learning inference runs on the edge device.
examples.hi: मशीन-लर्निंग अनुमान एज डिवाइस पर चलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We made an inference that he is guilty by seeing him.
common_mistake.right: We inferred that he was guilty from what we saw.
common_mistake.why: 'draw an inference' or use the verb 'infer from'

cloze.sentence: From the timing alone, the only safe ____ is that the two events are related.

en_def: honesty and strong moral principles; also, the state of being whole and unaltered
hi_nuance: Security uses 'data integrity' (unaltered). HR uses 'personal integrity' (honesty). Learners know only the moral sense. Both are uncountable.

examples.en: Hashes are used to verify the integrity of the downloaded file.
examples.hi: डाउनलोड की गई फ़ाइल की अखंडता सत्यापित करने के लिए हैश का उपयोग किया जाता है।

examples.en: She is respected for her integrity.
examples.hi: उसकी ईमानदारी के लिए उसका सम्मान किया जाता है।

examples.en: The attack compromised the integrity of the database.
examples.hi: हमले ने डेटाबेस की अखंडता से समझौता किया।

examples.en: He refused the bribe and kept his integrity intact.
examples.hi: उसने रिश्वत ठुकरा दी और अपनी सत्यनिष्ठा बरकरार रखी।

examples.en: Confidentiality, integrity, and availability are the three pillars of security.
examples.hi: गोपनीयता, अखंडता और उपलब्धता सुरक्षा के तीन स्तंभ हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: He has a good integrity.
common_mistake.right: He has great integrity.
common_mistake.why: integrity is uncountable; no article

cloze.sentence: Digital signatures protect the ____ of software updates.

en_def: the great size or importance of something
hi_nuance: 'An order of magnitude' means roughly ten times. Learners say 'size' or 'big-ness'. 'The magnitude of the problem' is the common phrase in reports.

examples.en: Nobody appreciated the magnitude of the problem until the logs were analysed.
examples.hi: लॉग का विश्लेषण होने तक किसी ने समस्या की विशालता को नहीं समझा।

examples.en: The new index made queries an order of magnitude faster.
examples.hi: नए इंडेक्स ने क्वेरी को दस गुना तेज़ बना दिया।

examples.en: An earthquake of magnitude 6.1 struck the coast.
examples.hi: तट पर 6.1 परिमाण का भूकंप आया।

examples.en: The task is of a magnitude the team has never faced.
examples.hi: यह कार्य ऐसे परिमाण का है जिसका सामना टीम ने कभी नहीं किया।

examples.en: We underestimated the magnitude of the migration.
examples.hi: हमने माइग्रेशन के परिमाण को कम आँका।

common_mistake.wrong: The magnitude of the loss was very big.
common_mistake.right: The magnitude of the loss was enormous.
common_mistake.why: 'magnitude' already means size; pair it with a strong adjective, not 'big'

cloze.sentence: The ____ of the leak became clear only after the third day.

en_def: a small difference in meaning, feeling, or tone
hi_nuance: This app's own field is named after it. Learners say 'small difference'. 'Capture the nuance', 'lose the nuance in translation' are typical.

examples.en: A machine translation often misses the nuances of tone.
examples.hi: मशीनी अनुवाद अक्सर लहजे की बारीकियों को छोड़ देता है।

examples.en: There is a nuance between 'a few' and 'few' that changes the meaning.
examples.hi: 'a few' और 'few' के बीच एक सूक्ष्म भेद है जो अर्थ बदल देता है।

examples.en: The negotiator understood every nuance of the offer.
examples.hi: वार्ताकार ने प्रस्ताव की हर बारीकी को समझा।

examples.en: The headline lost all the nuance of the original report.
examples.hi: शीर्षक ने मूल रिपोर्ट की सारी बारीकी खो दी।

examples.en: Severity ratings need nuance; not every finding is critical.
examples.hi: गंभीरता रेटिंग में बारीकी चाहिए; हर निष्कर्ष गंभीर नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: He explained the nuances differences.
common_mistake.right: He explained the nuances.
common_mistake.why: 'nuance' already means a fine difference; drop 'differences'

cloze.sentence: Learning the ____ between 'must' and 'have to' takes time.

en_def: an unintentional failure to notice something; also, supervision
hi_nuance: Two opposite-feeling meanings: 'a small oversight' (mistake) and 'regulatory oversight' (supervision). Context decides. Learners know only 'mistake'.

examples.en: Leaving the port open was an oversight, not a decision.
examples.hi: पोर्ट खुला छोड़ना एक चूक थी, कोई निर्णय नहीं।

examples.en: The committee provides oversight of the security programme.
examples.hi: समिति सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम की निगरानी करती है।

examples.en: Due to an oversight, the invoice was sent twice.
examples.hi: एक चूक के कारण चालान दो बार भेजा गया।

examples.en: There is little independent oversight of the agency.
examples.hi: एजेंसी की बहुत कम स्वतंत्र निगरानी है।

examples.en: The missing signature was a simple oversight.
examples.hi: हस्ताक्षर का न होना एक साधारण चूक थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Sorry, it was an overlook.
common_mistake.right: Sorry, it was an oversight.
common_mistake.why: 'overlook' is a verb; the noun is 'oversight'

cloze.sentence: The unrotated API key was an ____ that the audit caught.

en_def: a typical model or pattern of thinking about something
hi_def: प्रतिमान, आदर्श ढाँचा, सोच का मॉडल
hi_nuance: The 'g' is silent: /ˈpærədaɪm/. 'Paradigm shift' is overused business jargon; reserve it for a fundamental change. Learners also meet 'programming paradigm'.

examples.en: Zero trust represents a paradigm shift in network security.
examples.hi: ज़ीरो ट्रस्ट नेटवर्क सुरक्षा में सोच का मौलिक बदलाव है।

examples.en: Functional programming is a different paradigm from object-oriented programming.
examples.hi: फ़ंक्शनल प्रोग्रामिंग ऑब्जेक्ट-ओरिएंटेड प्रोग्रामिंग से अलग प्रतिमान है।

examples.en: The old paradigm assumed the perimeter could be trusted.
examples.hi: पुराने प्रतिमान में माना जाता था कि परिधि पर भरोसा किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: Her research challenged the dominant paradigm in the field.
examples.hi: उसके शोध ने क्षेत्र के प्रमुख प्रतिमान को चुनौती दी।

examples.en: The company became a paradigm of customer service.
examples.hi: कंपनी ग्राहक सेवा का आदर्श बन गई।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a paradigm shifting of thinking.
common_mistake.right: This is a paradigm shift in thinking.
common_mistake.why: the noun phrase is 'paradigm shift'

cloze.sentence: Cloud computing changed the ____ from owning servers to renting capacity.

en_def: a statement or idea that is accepted as the basis for an argument
hi_nuance: Singular 'premise' = assumption; plural 'premises' = a building ('on the premises'). Learners mix them. 'On-premise' software is technically wrong; 'on-premises' is correct.

examples.en: The argument rests on the premise that users never share passwords.
examples.hi: तर्क इस पूर्वधारणा पर टिका है कि उपयोगकर्ता कभी पासवर्ड साझा नहीं करते।

examples.en: If the premise is false, the conclusion cannot be trusted.
examples.hi: यदि आधार-वाक्य गलत है, तो निष्कर्ष पर भरोसा नहीं किया जा सकता।

examples.en: The whole plan is based on a faulty premise.
examples.hi: पूरी योजना एक गलत मान्यता पर आधारित है।

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed on the premises.
examples.hi: परिसर में धूम्रपान की अनुमति नहीं है।

examples.en: We run the database on-premises rather than in the cloud.
examples.hi: हम डेटाबेस को क्लाउड के बजाय अपने परिसर में चलाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Our servers are on-premise.
common_mistake.right: Our servers are on-premises.
common_mistake.why: the building sense is always plural 'premises'

cloze.sentence: The threat model starts from the ____ that the attacker is already inside.

en_def: something that must exist or happen before something else is possible
hi_nuance: Preposition: 'prerequisite for'. Learners say 'requirement'; a prerequisite must come first in time. Spelling: pre-requisite, not 'pre-requisite' with a hyphen in modern usage.

examples.en: A stable staging environment is a prerequisite for reliable testing.
examples.hi: विश्वसनीय परीक्षण के लिए स्थिर स्टेजिंग वातावरण एक पूर्वापेक्षा है।

examples.en: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for the machine-learning course.
examples.hi: मशीन-लर्निंग कोर्स के लिए बुनियादी सांख्यिकी एक पूर्वापेक्षा है।

examples.en: Trust is a prerequisite for honest post-mortems.
examples.hi: ईमानदार पोस्ट-मॉर्टम के लिए विश्वास एक पूर्वापेक्षा है।

examples.en: The installer checks that all prerequisites are present.
examples.hi: इंस्टॉलर जाँचता है कि सभी पूर्वापेक्षाएँ मौजूद हैं।

examples.en: Fluency is not a prerequisite for the job, but it helps.
examples.hi: नौकरी के लिए धाराप्रवाहता पूर्वापेक्षा नहीं है, लेकिन इससे मदद मिलती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Experience is a prerequisite of applying.
common_mistake.right: Experience is a prerequisite for applying.
common_mistake.why: prerequisite takes 'for'

cloze.sentence: Asset inventory is a ____ for any vulnerability-management programme.

en_def: nearness in space, time, or relationship
hi_nuance: 'In close proximity to' is common but slightly redundant (proximity already means closeness). Learners say 'nearness', which is rare. Physical security uses 'proximity card'.

examples.en: The office's proximity to the station is a big advantage.
examples.hi: स्टेशन से कार्यालय की निकटता एक बड़ा फ़ायदा है।

examples.en: The two events occurred in close proximity, which raised suspicion.
examples.hi: दोनों घटनाएँ बहुत नज़दीकी समय पर हुईं, जिससे संदेह पैदा हुआ।

examples.en: Staff enter the building using proximity cards.
examples.hi: कर्मचारी प्रॉक्सिमिटी कार्ड से इमारत में प्रवेश करते हैं।

examples.en: Bluetooth attacks require physical proximity to the target.
examples.hi: ब्लूटूथ हमलों के लिए लक्ष्य से भौतिक निकटता आवश्यक है।

examples.en: House prices rise with proximity to good schools.
examples.hi: अच्छे स्कूलों की निकटता के साथ मकान की कीमतें बढ़ती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The hotel is in proximity with the airport.
common_mistake.right: The hotel is in close proximity to the airport.
common_mistake.why: proximity takes 'to'

cloze.sentence: The attack required ____ to the badge reader, so remote exploitation was ruled out.

en_def: the set of reasons or logic behind a decision or belief
hi_nuance: Pronounced /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/, three syllables, unlike 'rational'. Learners say 'reason' or 'logic'. Reviewers often ask 'what is the rationale for this change?'.

examples.en: Please document the rationale for every firewall exception.
examples.hi: कृपया हर फ़ायरवॉल अपवाद के तर्काधार को दस्तावेज़ में लिखें।

examples.en: The rationale behind the decision was never explained to staff.
examples.hi: निर्णय के पीछे का तर्क कर्मचारियों को कभी नहीं समझाया गया।

examples.en: I understand the rationale, but I disagree with the conclusion.
examples.hi: मैं तर्काधार समझता हूँ, लेकिन निष्कर्ष से असहमत हूँ।

examples.en: The commit message should give the rationale, not just the change.
examples.hi: कमिट संदेश में केवल बदलाव नहीं, बल्कि उसका कारण भी होना चाहिए।

examples.en: There is a sound rationale for rotating keys every ninety days.
examples.hi: हर नब्बे दिन में कुंजी बदलने का एक ठोस तर्काधार है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the rational for this?
common_mistake.right: What is the rationale for this?
common_mistake.why: 'rational' is an adjective; the noun is 'rationale'

cloze.sentence: The design document explains the ____ for choosing a message queue.

en_def: an unintended, usually bad, consequence that occurs some time after an event
hi_def: दुष्परिणाम, प्रतिघात, बाद में आने वाला असर
hi_nuance: Usually plural and negative: 'serious repercussions'. Learners say 'side effects' or 'results'. Close to 'ramifications', but repercussions are felt later and hurt.

examples.en: The breach had repercussions for the company's share price months later.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन का महीनों बाद कंपनी के शेयर मूल्य पर दुष्परिणाम हुआ।

examples.en: Ignoring the warning could have serious repercussions.
examples.hi: चेतावनी को नज़रअंदाज़ करने के गंभीर दुष्परिणाम हो सकते हैं।

examples.en: The decision to outsource had political repercussions.
examples.hi: आउटसोर्स करने के निर्णय के राजनीतिक दुष्परिणाम हुए।

examples.en: Staff feared repercussions if they reported the problem.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों को डर था कि समस्या की रिपोर्ट करने पर उन्हें भुगतना पड़ेगा।

examples.en: The repercussions of the outage were felt across three countries.
examples.hi: आउटेज के दुष्परिणाम तीन देशों में महसूस किए गए।

common_mistake.wrong: There will be repercussion on the team.
common_mistake.right: There will be repercussions for the team.
common_mistake.why: usually plural, and takes 'for'

cloze.sentence: Publishing the exploit without a patch had ____ the researcher did not anticipate.

en_def: close and critical examination
hi_nuance: Noun of 'scrutinise'. Key phrases: 'under scrutiny', 'come under scrutiny', 'withstand scrutiny'. Learners say 'checking' or 'inspection'.

examples.en: The vendor's security claims did not withstand scrutiny.
examples.hi: विक्रेता के सुरक्षा दावे गहन जाँच में टिक नहीं पाए।

examples.en: The company's data practices have come under intense scrutiny.
examples.hi: कंपनी की डेटा प्रथाएँ गहन जाँच के दायरे में आ गई हैं।

examples.en: Every pull request to the auth module gets extra scrutiny.
examples.hi: ऑथ मॉड्यूल के हर पुल रिक्वेस्ट की अतिरिक्त जाँच होती है।

examples.en: Public figures must accept a degree of scrutiny.
examples.hi: सार्वजनिक हस्तियों को कुछ हद तक जाँच स्वीकार करनी होगी।

examples.en: The figures will be subject to close scrutiny by the regulator.
examples.hi: आँकड़े नियामक द्वारा बारीक जाँच के अधीन होंगे।
