common_mistake.wrong: The plan is under scrutinise.
common_mistake.right: The plan is under scrutiny.
common_mistake.why: after 'under' use the noun 'scrutiny'

cloze.sentence: The new encryption library was released only after months of public ____.

en_def: the level or point at which something starts to happen or take effect
hi_nuance: Starts with /θ/ (think), not /t/. Monitoring: 'alert threshold'. Tax: 'income threshold'. Learners say 'limit', which is the maximum, whereas a threshold is the trigger point.

examples.en: An alert fires when CPU usage crosses the 80% threshold.
examples.hi: जब सीपीयू उपयोग 80% की सीमा पार करता है तो अलर्ट चालू होता है।

examples.en: The tax-free threshold was raised this year.
examples.hi: इस वर्ष कर-मुक्त सीमा बढ़ाई गई।

examples.en: She has a high pain threshold.
examples.hi: उसकी दर्द सहने की सीमा ऊँची है।

examples.en: We are on the threshold of a new era in computing.
examples.hi: हम कंप्यूटिंग के एक नए युग की दहलीज़ पर हैं।

examples.en: Set the failed-login threshold to five attempts.
examples.hi: विफल-लॉगिन सीमा को पाँच प्रयासों पर सेट करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The threshold limit for alerts is 80%.
common_mistake.right: The alert threshold is 80%.
common_mistake.why: 'threshold limit' is redundant

cloze.sentence: Once error rates pass the ____, the deployment rolls back automatically.

en_def: a balance between two things you cannot have fully at the same time
hi_def: समझौता, अदला-बदली, एक के बदले दूसरे का त्याग
hi_nuance: Learners say 'compromise' (which can sound like giving up) or 'balance'. Engineers live with trade-offs: 'a trade-off between speed and security'. Preposition: 'trade-off between'.

examples.en: There is always a trade-off between usability and security.
examples.hi: उपयोगिता और सुरक्षा के बीच हमेशा एक समझौता होता है।

examples.en: Caching is a trade-off: faster reads but possibly stale data.
examples.hi: कैशिंग एक अदला-बदली है: तेज़ रीड लेकिन संभवतः पुराना डेटा।

examples.en: The team accepted the trade-off of a slower release for better testing.
examples.hi: टीम ने बेहतर परीक्षण के बदले धीमी रिलीज़ का समझौता स्वीकार किया।

examples.en: Every architecture decision involves trade-offs.
examples.hi: हर आर्किटेक्चर निर्णय में समझौते शामिल होते हैं।

examples.en: Document the trade-offs so future engineers understand the choice.
examples.hi: समझौतों को दस्तावेज़ में लिखें ताकि भविष्य के इंजीनियर चुनाव को समझ सकें।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a trade-off of speed with security.
common_mistake.right: There is a trade-off between speed and security.
common_mistake.why: 'trade-off between X and Y'

cloze.sentence: Longer passwords improve security, but the ____ is user frustration.

en_def: the path something follows through space, or the direction in which something develops
hi_nuance: Physics word used metaphorically: 'career trajectory', 'growth trajectory'. Learners say 'path' or 'direction'. 'On an upward trajectory' is common.

examples.en: The company is on a strong growth trajectory.
examples.hi: कंपनी मज़बूत विकास के मार्ग पर है।

examples.en: Her career trajectory took her from support to security architecture.
examples.hi: उसके करियर का मार्ग उसे सहायता से सुरक्षा वास्तुकला तक ले गया।

examples.en: The missile's trajectory was tracked by radar.
examples.hi: मिसाइल के प्रक्षेप-पथ को रडार द्वारा ट्रैक किया गया।

examples.en: Without intervention, the debt is on an unsustainable trajectory.
examples.hi: हस्तक्षेप के बिना, ऋण एक अस्थिर मार्ग पर है।

examples.en: The incident changed the trajectory of the whole project.
examples.hi: घटना ने पूरी परियोजना की दिशा बदल दी।

common_mistake.wrong: The company is in a good trajectory.
common_mistake.right: The company is on a good trajectory.
common_mistake.why: the preposition is 'on'

cloze.sentence: Weekly shadowing put my pronunciation scores on an upward ____.

en_def: the quality of being logically sound, legally acceptable, or still in effect
hi_nuance: Three senses: an argument's validity (logic), a certificate's validity (legal), a visa's validity period (time). Learners use 'validation' (the process) when they mean 'validity' (the state).

examples.en: The auditor questioned the validity of the test results.
examples.hi: ऑडिटर ने परीक्षण परिणामों की वैधता पर सवाल उठाया।

examples.en: The certificate's validity period is one year.
examples.hi: प्रमाणपत्र की वैधता अवधि एक वर्ष है।

examples.en: There is some validity to his argument.
examples.hi: उसके तर्क में कुछ वैधता है।

examples.en: The court will rule on the validity of the contract.
examples.hi: अदालत अनुबंध की वैधता पर फ़ैसला देगी।

examples.en: Check the validity of the token before processing the request.
examples.hi: अनुरोध को संसाधित करने से पहले टोकन की वैधता जाँचें।

common_mistake.wrong: Check the validation of the certificate.
common_mistake.right: Check the validity of the certificate.
common_mistake.why: validation is the act of checking; validity is the state being checked

cloze.sentence: The ____ of the survey is limited by its small sample.

en_def: the ability to work successfully or survive over time
hi_def: व्यवहार्यता, टिकाऊपन, सफल होने की क्षमता
hi_nuance: Noun of 'viable'. 'Commercial viability', 'long-term viability'. Learners say 'possibility'. Note the pronunciation: vai-uh-BIL-i-ty.

examples.en: The board questioned the long-term viability of the product.
examples.hi: बोर्ड ने उत्पाद की दीर्घकालिक व्यवहार्यता पर सवाल उठाया।

examples.en: A pilot project will test the viability of the new approach.
examples.hi: एक पायलट परियोजना नए दृष्टिकोण की व्यवहार्यता का परीक्षण करेगी।

examples.en: Rising costs threaten the viability of small farms.
examples.hi: बढ़ती लागत छोटे खेतों की व्यवहार्यता को ख़तरे में डालती है।

examples.en: We assessed the commercial viability before investing.
examples.hi: निवेश से पहले हमने व्यावसायिक व्यवहार्यता का आकलन किया।

examples.en: The viability of self-hosting depends on having staff to maintain it.
examples.hi: सेल्फ़-होस्टिंग की व्यवहार्यता उसे बनाए रखने के लिए कर्मचारियों की उपलब्धता पर निर्भर करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We doubt the viable of the plan.
common_mistake.right: We doubt the viability of the plan.
common_mistake.why: after 'the' a noun is required

cloze.sentence: The ____ of the open-source project depends on a handful of volunteers.

en_def: understanding of a situation only after it has happened
hi_nuance: Fixed phrases: 'in hindsight', 'with the benefit of hindsight', 'hindsight is 20/20'. Learners say 'now I realise', which is fine but longer. Never 'in the hindsight'.

examples.en: In hindsight, we should have rotated the keys immediately.
examples.hi: बाद में सोचने पर, हमें तुरंत कुंजियाँ बदल देनी चाहिए थीं।

examples.en: With the benefit of hindsight, the warning signs were obvious.
examples.hi: पश्चदृष्टि से, चेतावनी के संकेत स्पष्ट थे।

examples.en: Hindsight is always 20/20.
examples.hi: बीती बात के बारे में हर कोई समझदार होता है।

examples.en: It is easy to criticise the decision in hindsight.
examples.hi: बाद में उस निर्णय की आलोचना करना आसान है।

examples.en: Post-mortems should avoid hindsight bias.
examples.hi: पोस्ट-मॉर्टम को पश्चदृष्टि पूर्वाग्रह से बचना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: In the hindsight, it was a mistake.
common_mistake.right: In hindsight, it was a mistake.
common_mistake.why: no article in the fixed phrase

cloze.sentence: In ____, the unusual login from Brazil should have triggered an alert.

en_def: a possible future event that must be prepared for; also, money or plans kept for such events
hi_nuance: 'Contingency plan' is the phrase everyone needs. Learners say 'backup plan' (fine in speech). 'Contingency' alone can mean the reserve budget.

examples.en: Every incident-response plan needs a contingency for when the primary contact is unreachable.
examples.hi: हर घटना-प्रतिक्रिया योजना में इस स्थिति के लिए आकस्मिक व्यवस्था होनी चाहिए कि प्राथमिक संपर्क उपलब्ध न हो।

examples.en: We have a contingency plan if the data centre loses power.
examples.hi: यदि डेटा केंद्र की बिजली चली जाए तो हमारे पास आपात योजना है।

examples.en: The budget includes a 10% contingency for unexpected costs.
examples.hi: बजट में अप्रत्याशित लागतों के लिए 10% आकस्मिक निधि शामिल है।

examples.en: We planned for every contingency we could think of.
examples.hi: हमने हर संभावित आकस्मिकता के लिए योजना बनाई जो हम सोच सके।

examples.en: Contingency arrangements kept the service running during the strike.
examples.hi: आपात व्यवस्थाओं ने हड़ताल के दौरान सेवा को चालू रखा।

common_mistake.wrong: We need a contingent plan.
common_mistake.right: We need a contingency plan.
common_mistake.why: the noun 'contingency' is used attributively; 'contingent' means dependent

cloze.sentence: The ____ plan calls for failing over to the secondary region within an hour.

en_def: a gradual reduction in numbers, especially of staff leaving and not being replaced
hi_def: क्षरण, कर्मचारियों का धीरे-धीरे कम होना
hi_nuance: Indian HR uses 'attrition rate' constantly. Also 'war of attrition' (wearing the enemy down). Learners should not confuse it with 'turnover', which includes replacements.

examples.en: High attrition in the security team left critical systems unowned.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा टीम में उच्च क्षरण ने महत्वपूर्ण सिस्टमों को बिना मालिक के छोड़ दिया।

examples.en: The company reduced headcount through natural attrition.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने प्राकृतिक क्षरण के माध्यम से कर्मचारियों की संख्या कम की।

examples.en: Attrition rates in call centres are notoriously high.
examples.hi: कॉल सेंटरों में क्षरण दर बदनाम रूप से ऊँची है।

examples.en: The negotiation became a war of attrition.
examples.hi: वार्ता एक थकाऊ खींचतान बन गई।

examples.en: Customer attrition fell after the loyalty programme launched.
examples.hi: लॉयल्टी कार्यक्रम शुरू होने के बाद ग्राहक क्षरण कम हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: Our attrition is very less this year.
common_mistake.right: Our attrition is very low this year.
common_mistake.why: 'very less' is not English; use 'low' with rates

cloze.sentence: Knowledge is lost through ____ unless it is documented.

en_def: a point where progress is slowed because capacity is limited
hi_nuance: From the narrow neck of a bottle. Engineers use it for performance; managers for approvals ('the CISO's sign-off is the bottleneck'). Learners say 'blockage' or 'delay point'.

examples.en: The database has become the bottleneck for the whole application.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस पूरे एप्लिकेशन के लिए अड़चन बन गया है।

examples.en: Manual approvals are a bottleneck in the release process.
examples.hi: मैन्युअल अनुमोदन रिलीज़ प्रक्रिया में एक अड़चन है।

examples.en: Profiling revealed a bottleneck in the image-resizing code.
examples.hi: प्रोफ़ाइलिंग ने इमेज-रीसाइज़िंग कोड में एक अड़चन उजागर की।

examples.en: A single reviewer creates a bottleneck for the team.
examples.hi: एक ही समीक्षक टीम के लिए अड़चन पैदा करता है।

examples.en: Traffic bottlenecks form near the bridge every morning.
examples.hi: हर सुबह पुल के पास यातायात की अड़चन बनती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The approval step is a bottleneck point.
common_mistake.right: The approval step is a bottleneck.
common_mistake.why: 'bottleneck' already means a point; drop 'point'

cloze.sentence: The single TLS-terminating proxy is the ____ under peak load.

en_def: used to say that there are good reasons for a claim, though it could be disputed
hi_def: तर्कसंगत रूप से, कहा जा सकता है कि
hi_nuance: A hedge that makes strong claims sound reasonable: 'arguably the best'. Learners state opinions as facts; 'arguably' shows awareness of other views.

examples.en: Phishing is arguably the biggest threat to most organisations.
examples.hi: कहा जा सकता है कि फ़िशिंग अधिकांश संगठनों के लिए सबसे बड़ा ख़तरा है।

examples.en: She is arguably the most experienced engineer on the team.
examples.hi: तर्कसंगत रूप से वह टीम की सबसे अनुभवी इंजीनियर है।

examples.en: The second approach is arguably simpler.
examples.hi: कहा जा सकता है कि दूसरा तरीका सरल है।

examples.en: This was arguably the company's worst decision.
examples.hi: यह तर्कसंगत रूप से कंपनी का सबसे बुरा निर्णय था।

examples.en: Arguably, the delay saved us from a much bigger failure.
examples.hi: कहा जा सकता है कि देरी ने हमें कहीं बड़ी विफलता से बचाया।

common_mistake.wrong: Arguably, this is definitely the best.
common_mistake.right: This is arguably the best.
common_mistake.why: 'arguably' hedges; 'definitely' cancels the hedge

cloze.sentence: Multi-factor authentication is ____ the single most effective control.

en_def: apparently or supposedly, but perhaps not really
hi_def: ऊपरी तौर पर, दिखावे के लिए, कथित रूप से
hi_nuance: Signals doubt: 'ostensibly for security reasons' means you suspect another motive. Learners use 'apparently', which is neutral; 'ostensibly' is sceptical.

examples.en: The email was ostensibly from the CEO, but the headers told a different story.
examples.hi: ईमेल ऊपरी तौर पर सीईओ से था, लेकिन हेडर एक अलग कहानी बता रहे थे।

examples.en: The meeting was ostensibly about budgets, but really about layoffs.
examples.hi: बैठक ऊपरी तौर पर बजट के बारे में थी, लेकिन वास्तव में छँटनी के बारे में।

examples.en: He resigned, ostensibly for health reasons.
examples.hi: उसने कथित रूप से स्वास्थ्य कारणों से इस्तीफ़ा दिया।

examples.en: The app requests location access, ostensibly to show nearby stores.
examples.hi: ऐप स्थान की पहुँच माँगता है, दिखावे के लिए आस-पास की दुकानें दिखाने हेतु।

examples.en: The change was ostensibly a bug fix.
examples.hi: बदलाव ऊपरी तौर पर एक बग फ़िक्स था।

common_mistake.wrong: He is ostensibly a good engineer, and he really is.
common_mistake.right: He is ostensibly a good engineer, but his code says otherwise.
common_mistake.why: 'ostensibly' implies doubt; do not follow it with confirmation

cloze.sentence: The attachment was ____ an invoice, but it contained a macro.

en_def: in spite of; despite
hi_nuance: Legal and very formal. Can go before or after the noun: 'notwithstanding the delay' or 'the delay notwithstanding'. In normal writing use 'despite'. Never followed by 'of'.

examples.en: Notwithstanding the objections, the policy was approved.
examples.hi: आपत्तियों के बावजूद, नीति को मंज़ूरी दे दी गई।

examples.en: The project succeeded, its rocky start notwithstanding.
examples.hi: अपनी कठिन शुरुआत के बावजूद परियोजना सफल रही।

examples.en: Notwithstanding clause 4, the supplier remains liable for data loss.
examples.hi: खंड 4 के बावजूद, आपूर्तिकर्ता डेटा हानि के लिए उत्तरदायी बना रहता है।

examples.en: The team shipped on time, notwithstanding two resignations.
examples.hi: दो इस्तीफ़ों के बावजूद टीम ने समय पर डिलीवर किया।

examples.en: Notwithstanding its age, the system is still reliable.
examples.hi: अपनी उम्र के बावजूद, सिस्टम अभी भी विश्वसनीय है।

common_mistake.wrong: Notwithstanding of the rain, we went.
common_mistake.right: Notwithstanding the rain, we went.
common_mistake.why: notwithstanding is never followed by 'of'

cloze.sentence: ____ the vendor's assurances, we ran our own penetration test.

en_def: although; used to add a qualifying comment
hi_def: हालाँकि, यद्यपि (एक छोटी शर्त जोड़ने के लिए)
hi_nuance: Pronounced 'all-BE-it'. Unlike 'although', it cannot introduce a full clause with a verb: 'a fix, albeit a temporary one' (correct); 'albeit it was temporary' (wrong).

examples.en: We found a fix, albeit a temporary one.
examples.hi: हमें एक समाधान मिला, हालाँकि अस्थायी।

examples.en: The results were positive, albeit with a small sample.
examples.hi: परिणाम सकारात्मक थे, हालाँकि नमूना छोटा था।

examples.en: She agreed, albeit reluctantly.
examples.hi: वह सहमत हुई, हालाँकि अनिच्छा से।

examples.en: The server responded, albeit slowly.
examples.hi: सर्वर ने प्रतिक्रिया दी, हालाँकि धीरे।

examples.en: Progress has been made, albeit less than we hoped.
examples.hi: प्रगति हुई है, हालाँकि उम्मीद से कम।

common_mistake.wrong: The fix worked, albeit it was slow.
common_mistake.right: The fix worked, albeit slowly.
common_mistake.why: albeit takes a phrase, not a full clause with a subject and verb

cloze.sentence: The patch was released, ____ two weeks later than promised.

en_def: to the extent that
hi_def: जहाँ तक, इस हद तक कि
hi_nuance: Very formal, used to limit a statement precisely: 'The tool is useful insofar as it finds known flaws'. Learners say 'as much as' or 'as far as', which are looser. Also written 'in so far as'.

examples.en: The scanner is useful insofar as it detects known vulnerabilities.
examples.hi: स्कैनर उस हद तक उपयोगी है जहाँ तक वह ज्ञात कमज़ोरियों का पता लगाता है।

examples.en: We will help insofar as our budget allows.
examples.hi: हम उतनी मदद करेंगे जितनी हमारा बजट अनुमति देता है।

examples.en: The theory is correct insofar as it goes.
examples.hi: सिद्धांत जहाँ तक जाता है, वहाँ तक सही है।

examples.en: Insofar as the data is reliable, the trend is downward.
examples.hi: जहाँ तक डेटा विश्वसनीय है, प्रवृत्ति नीचे की ओर है।

examples.en: The policy applies insofar as it does not conflict with local law.
examples.hi: नीति उस हद तक लागू होती है जहाँ तक वह स्थानीय कानून से टकराती नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: Insofar as I know, he left.
common_mistake.right: As far as I know, he left.
common_mistake.why: 'insofar as' limits a statement's extent; for knowledge use 'as far as I know'

cloze.sentence: The logs are trustworthy only ____ they have not been tampered with.

en_def: until now; until the point being discussed
hi_nuance: Literary and formal. Common in academic writing: 'a hitherto unknown vulnerability'. In everyday writing use 'until now' or 'previously'. Starts with /h/ and has /ð/ in the middle.

examples.en: The researchers discovered a hitherto unknown flaw in the chip.
examples.hi: शोधकर्ताओं ने चिप में अब तक अज्ञात एक खामी की खोज की।

examples.en: Hitherto, the company had relied entirely on perimeter defences.
examples.hi: अब तक कंपनी पूरी तरह परिधि सुरक्षा पर निर्भर थी।

examples.en: The archive contains hitherto unpublished letters.
examples.hi: अभिलेखागार में अब तक अप्रकाशित पत्र हैं।

examples.en: This opens up markets that were hitherto closed to us.
examples.hi: इससे वे बाज़ार खुलते हैं जो अब तक हमारे लिए बंद थे।

examples.en: The bug affected a hitherto stable module.
examples.hi: बग ने अब तक स्थिर रहे एक मॉड्यूल को प्रभावित किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Hitherto now, nobody noticed.
common_mistake.right: Hitherto, nobody had noticed.
common_mistake.why: 'hitherto' already means 'until now'; do not add 'now'

cloze.sentence: The attack used a ____ unreported technique for bypassing the sandbox.

en_def: introducing a statement that reverses the one just made
hi_nuance: Only for true reversals (A causes B; conversely, not-A causes not-B). Learners use it as a synonym for 'however', which is wrong. Sentence-initial with a comma.

examples.en: Strict rules reduce risk; conversely, loose rules increase it.
examples.hi: सख़्त नियम जोखिम कम करते हैं; इसके विपरीत, ढीले नियम उसे बढ़ाते हैं।

examples.en: Some people learn best by reading. Conversely, others need to hear the words.
examples.hi: कुछ लोग पढ़कर सबसे अच्छा सीखते हैं। इसके विपरीत, दूसरों को शब्द सुनने की ज़रूरत होती है।

examples.en: Faster releases mean more bugs; conversely, slower releases mean fewer.
examples.hi: तेज़ रिलीज़ का मतलब अधिक बग; इसके विपरीत, धीमी रिलीज़ का मतलब कम बग।

examples.en: High interest rates cool the economy. Conversely, low rates stimulate it.
examples.hi: ऊँची ब्याज दरें अर्थव्यवस्था को ठंडा करती हैं। इसके विपरीत, कम दरें उसे प्रोत्साहित करती हैं।

examples.en: Long passwords are hard to crack; conversely, short ones fall in seconds.
examples.hi: लंबे पासवर्ड तोड़ना कठिन है; इसके विपरीत, छोटे पासवर्ड सेकंडों में टूट जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: It rained. Conversely, we stayed in.
common_mistake.right: It rained, so we stayed in.
common_mistake.why: 'conversely' signals a reversed relationship, not a consequence

cloze.sentence: More logging aids investigation; ____, it also increases storage costs.

en_def: in spite of what has just been said; nevertheless
hi_nuance: Same meaning as 'nevertheless', slightly less formal. Learners write 'but nonetheless' (redundant) or 'none the less' as three words (old-fashioned).

examples.en: The fix was late. Nonetheless, it solved the problem completely.
examples.hi: सुधार देर से आया। फिर भी, उसने समस्या को पूरी तरह हल कर दिया।

examples.en: The evidence is circumstantial but nonetheless persuasive.
examples.hi: सबूत परिस्थितिजन्य हैं लेकिन फिर भी विश्वसनीय हैं।

examples.en: She knew the risks; she went ahead nonetheless.
examples.hi: वह जोखिम जानती थी; फिर भी वह आगे बढ़ी।

examples.en: It is a small improvement, but a real one nonetheless.
examples.hi: यह एक छोटा सुधार है, लेकिन फिर भी वास्तविक है।

examples.en: The tool has limits. Nonetheless, it caught three critical flaws.
examples.hi: टूल की सीमाएँ हैं। फिर भी, उसने तीन गंभीर खामियाँ पकड़ीं।

common_mistake.wrong: The test failed, but however nonetheless we shipped.
common_mistake.right: The test failed. Nonetheless, we shipped.
common_mistake.why: use one contrast word, not three

cloze.sentence: The vendor's patch was incomplete; we deployed it ____ to reduce exposure.

en_def: by that means; as a result of that action
hi_nuance: Usually followed by an -ing form: 'thereby reducing risk'. Learners write 'thereby it reduces', which is wrong. Common in reports to link an action to its effect in one sentence.

examples.en: We enabled rate limiting, thereby blocking most brute-force attempts.
examples.hi: हमने दर सीमा सक्षम की, जिससे अधिकांश ब्रूट-फ़ोर्स प्रयास रुक गए।

examples.en: The company cut its workforce, thereby reducing costs by 15%.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने अपने कार्यबल में कटौती की, जिससे लागत 15% कम हुई।

examples.en: She documented every step, thereby making the process repeatable.
examples.hi: उसने हर कदम को दस्तावेज़ में लिखा, जिससे प्रक्रिया दोहराने योग्य बन गई।

examples.en: The attacker gained admin rights, thereby compromising the whole domain.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने एडमिन अधिकार प्राप्त किए, जिससे पूरा डोमेन समझौते में आ गया।

examples.en: Backups are tested monthly, thereby ensuring they can actually be restored.
examples.hi: बैकअप का मासिक परीक्षण किया जाता है, जिससे यह सुनिश्चित होता है कि उन्हें वास्तव में बहाल किया जा सकता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We added caching, thereby it became faster.
common_mistake.right: We added caching, thereby making it faster.
common_mistake.why: thereby is followed by an -ing phrase, not a new clause

cloze.sentence: The team automated the checks, ____ removing a manual bottleneck.

en_def: by which; according to which
hi_nuance: Introduces how a system or arrangement works: 'a scheme whereby users earn points'. Learners write 'in which' (fine) or 'where' (less precise). Formal.

examples.en: We introduced a process whereby every change is reviewed by two engineers.
examples.hi: हमने एक प्रक्रिया शुरू की जिसके अनुसार हर बदलाव की समीक्षा दो इंजीनियर करते हैं।

examples.en: The company has a scheme whereby staff can buy shares at a discount.
examples.hi: कंपनी की एक योजना है जिसके द्वारा कर्मचारी छूट पर शेयर खरीद सकते हैं।

examples.en: The attack used a technique whereby the token is replayed within its validity window.
examples.hi: हमले में एक तकनीक का उपयोग हुआ जिसके द्वारा टोकन को उसकी वैधता अवधि के भीतर दोबारा भेजा जाता है।

examples.en: They reached an agreement whereby both parties share the cost.
examples.hi: वे एक समझौते पर पहुँचे जिसके अनुसार दोनों पक्ष लागत साझा करते हैं।

examples.en: There is a mechanism whereby users can report false positives.
examples.hi: एक तंत्र है जिसके द्वारा उपयोगकर्ता गलत सकारात्मक परिणामों की रिपोर्ट कर सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We have a rule whereby that all data is encrypted.
common_mistake.right: We have a rule whereby all data is encrypted.
common_mistake.why: do not add 'that' after whereby

cloze.sentence: The bank offers a service ____ customers can freeze their card instantly.

en_def: for this reason; therefore
hi_nuance: Indian academic English overuses 'hence' in speech. It is fine in writing, especially before a noun phrase: 'hence the delay'. In conversation say 'so'. Never 'hence why' (redundant).

examples.en: The key was leaked; hence the emergency rotation.
examples.hi: कुंजी लीक हो गई थी; इसलिए आपातकालीन रोटेशन किया गया।

examples.en: Demand exceeded supply, hence the price rise.
examples.hi: माँग आपूर्ति से अधिक थी, इसलिए कीमत बढ़ी।

examples.en: The library is unmaintained and hence a security risk.
examples.hi: लाइब्रेरी का रखरखाव नहीं होता और इसलिए यह एक सुरक्षा जोखिम है।

examples.en: The bug is in shared code; hence every service is affected.
examples.hi: बग साझा कोड में है; इसलिए हर सेवा प्रभावित है।

examples.en: The tests were skipped, hence the regression.
examples.hi: परीक्षण छोड़ दिए गए थे, इसलिए रिग्रेशन हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: That is hence why we failed.
common_mistake.right: That is why we failed.
common_mistake.why: 'hence why' is redundant; use one or the other

cloze.sentence: The certificate expired at midnight, ____ the outage.
